From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Sets.Ensembles.
Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping Bigstep ViewpointAdaptation Reachability.

Definition reachable_locations_from_vals
  (h : heap) (vals : list value) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists l_root,
      List.In (Iot l_root) vals /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Theorem readonly_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Hreadonly_scope : readonly_state_method_scope mt)
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg))
    (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.

Theorem transitive_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg)),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers.

Inductive method_scope_subtype : method_scope -> method_scope -> Prop :=
  | method_subtyping_refl : forall mt,
      method_scope_subtype mt mt
  | method_cs_as : method_scope_subtype ConcreteState AbstractState
  | method_rs_as : method_scope_subtype ReadonlyState AbstractState
  | method_ts_as : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState AbstractState
  | method_ts_cs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ConcreteState
  | method_ts_rs : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState ReadonlyState
  .

Inductive q_subtype : q -> q -> Prop :=
  | q_refl : forall q1
      (Hnot_lost : q1 <> Lost),
      q_subtype q1 q1
  | q_rd : forall q1,
      q_subtype q1 RO
  | q_bot : forall q1,
      q_subtype Bot q1
where "q1 ⊑ q2" := (q_subtype q1 q2).

Definition parent_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_name :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => super (signature def)
  | None => None
  end.

Inductive base_subtype : class_table -> class_name -> class_name -> Prop :=
  | base_refl : forall (CT : class_table) (C : class_name)
      (Hdom : C < dom CT),
      base_subtype CT C C
  | base_trans : forall (CT : class_table) (C D E : class_name)
      (Hsub1 : base_subtype CT C D)
      (Hsub2 : base_subtype CT D E),
      base_subtype CT C E
  | base_extends : forall (CT : class_table) (C D : class_name)
      (Hdom_C  : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_D  : D < dom CT)
      (Hparent : parent_lookup CT C = Some D),
      base_subtype CT C D.

Inductive qualified_type_subtype : class_table -> qualified_type -> qualified_type -> Prop :=
  | qtype_sub : forall CT qt1 qt2
      (Hdom1  : sctype qt1 < dom CT)
      (Hdom2  : sctype qt2 < dom CT)
      (Hqsub  : q_subtype (sqtype qt1) (sqtype qt2))
      (Hbsub  : base_subtype CT (sctype qt1) (sctype qt2)),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2
  | qtype_trans : forall CT qt1 qt2 qt3
      (Hsub12 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2)
      (Hsub23 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt2 qt3),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt3
  | qtype_refl : forall CT qt
      (Hdom      : sctype qt < dom CT)
      (Hnot_lost : sqtype qt <> Lost),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt qt.
Require Import Syntax.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | Mut, Mut => Mut
    | _, Mut => Lost
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with






    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | Mut, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, Mut_f => Lost
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_assignability (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_assignability_cs_ts (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | Mut, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_bound (q1: q)(q2 : q_c) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_c => Lost
    | q1, RDM_c => q1
    | _, Imm_c => Imm
    | _, Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (q1: q_c)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_c, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_c, RDM_f => Mut
    | RDM_c, RDM_f => RDM
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_rec_fld (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM_f => Mut
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime (q1: q_r)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM => Mut
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_object_creation (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : q_r :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_c => Imm_r
    | Mut_r, RDM_c => Mut_r
    | _, Imm_c => Imm_r
    | _, Mut_c => Mut_r
    end.

  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

Inductive eval_result :=
| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Inductive eval_expr : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> expr -> value -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Val : forall CT rΓ h x v
      (Hval : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EVar x) v OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field : forall CT rΓ h x f v o v1
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot v))
      (Hobj   : runtime_getObj h v = Some o)
      (Hfield : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some v1),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) v1 OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) Null_a NPE rΓ h
  .

Inductive eval_stmt : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> stmt -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | SBS_Skip : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h SSkip OK rΓ h


  | SBS_Local : forall CT rΓ h T x
      (Hnone : runtime_getVal rΓ x = None),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SLocal T x) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (rΓ.(vars)++[Null_a]) )
      h


  | SBS_Assign : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 OK rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (update x v2 rΓ.(vars)))
      h

  | SBS_Assign_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 NPE rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) NPE
      rΓ
      h


  | SBS_FldWrite : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y h'
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hruntime_assignable : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable)
      (Hupdate : h' = update_field h loc_x f val_y),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) OK rΓ h'


  | SBS_FldWrite_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f y
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hfinal  : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Final),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) MUTATIONEXP rΓ h


  | SBS_New : forall CT rΓ h x (q_c:q_c) c ys l1 qthisr vals o qadapted rΓ' h'
      (Hthis    : runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hargs    : runtime_lookup_list rΓ ys = Some vals)
      (Hmut     : r_muttype h l1 = Some qthisr)
      (Hadapt   : vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c = qadapted)
      (Hobj     : o = mkObj (mkruntime_type qadapted c) (vals))
      (Hheap    : h' = h++[o])
      (Henv     : rΓ' = (set_vars rΓ (update x (Iot (dom h)) rΓ.(vars)))),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SNew x q_c c ys) OK rΓ' h'


  | SBS_Call : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret retval h' rΓ' rΓ'' rΓ'''
      (Hval_y      : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase       : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind       : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt       : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret        : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs       : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe      : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body  : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt OK rΓ'' h')
      (Hretval     : runtime_getVal rΓ'' mret = Some retval)
      (Henv        : rΓ''' = (set_vars rΓ (update x retval rΓ.(vars)))),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) OK rΓ''' h'


  | SBS_Call_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_Call_NPE_Body : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret h' rΓ' rΓ''
      (Hval_y     : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase      : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind      : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt      : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret       : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs      : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe     : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt NPE rΓ'' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) NPE rΓ'' h'

  | SBS_Call_MUTATIONEXP_Body : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret h' rΓ' rΓ''
      (Hval_y     : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase      : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind      : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt      : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret       : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs      : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe     : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h'

  | SBS_Seq : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 OK rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) OK rΓ'' h''

  | SBS_Seq_NPE_first : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h'
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 NPE rΓ' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) NPE rΓ' h'

  | SBS_Seq_NPE_second : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 NPE rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) NPE rΓ'' h''

  | SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_first : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h'
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 MUTATIONEXP rΓ' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) MUTATIONEXP rΓ' h'

  | SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_second : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h''
  .

Require Import Syntax Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Helpers.

From Stdlib Require String.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Inductive CollectFields : class_table -> class_name -> list field_def -> Prop :=

  | CF_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_fields own_fields
      (Hfind        : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper       : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_cf   : CollectFields CT parent parent_fields)
      (Hown_fields  : own_fields = Syntax.fields (body def)),
      CollectFields CT C (parent_fields ++ own_fields).

Inductive FieldLookup : class_table -> class_name -> var -> field_def -> Prop :=
  | FL_Found : forall CT C fields f fdef
      (Hcf  : CollectFields CT C fields)
      (Hget : gget fields f = Some fdef),
      FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_def_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_assignability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (a: a) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ assignability (ftype fdef) = a.

Definition sf_mutability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (qf: q_f) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ mutability (ftype fdef) = qf.

Definition constructor_def_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_def :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => Some (constructor (body def))
  | None => None
  end.

Definition constructor_sig_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_sig :=
  match constructor_def_lookup CT C with
  | Some ctor => Some (csignature ctor)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition eq_method_name (m1 m2 : method_name) : bool :=
  match m1, m2 with
  | n1, n2 => Nat.eqb n1 n2
  end.

Definition gget_method (methods : list method_def) (m : method_name) : option method_def :=
  find (fun mdef => eq_method_name (mname (msignature mdef)) m) methods.

Definition override (parent_methods own_methods : list method_def) : list method_def :=
  own_methods ++ filter (fun pmdef =>
    negb (existsb (fun omdef =>
      eq_method_name (mname (msignature pmdef)) (mname (msignature omdef)))
    own_methods)) parent_methods.

Inductive CollectMethods : class_table -> class_name -> list method_def -> Prop :=

  | CM_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectMethods CT C []


  | CM_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None)
      (Hdom   : C < dom CT),
      CollectMethods CT C (methods (body def))


  | CM_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_methods own_methods merged
      (Hfind          : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper         : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hdom_C         : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_parent    : parent < dom CT)
      (Hordering      : cname (signature def) > parent)
      (Hparent_cm     : CollectMethods CT parent parent_methods)
      (Hown_methods   : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hmerged        : merged = override parent_methods own_methods),
      CollectMethods CT C merged.

Definition wf_stypeuse (CT : class_table) (q_use: q) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match bound CT c with
  | Some q_bound =>



                  q_subtype (vpa_mutability_bound q_use q_bound) q_use /\
                   c < dom CT
  | None => False
  end.

Definition qf2q (qf : q_f) : q :=
  match qf with
  | Mut_f => Mut
  | Imm_f => Imm
  | RDM_f => RDM
  | RO_f => RO
  end.

Definition wf_field (CT : class_table) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  wf_stypeuse CT (qf2q (mutability (ftype fdef)))
    (f_base_type (ftype fdef)).

Definition wf_senv (CT : class_table) (sΓ : s_env) : Prop :=

  dom sΓ > 0 /\
  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) sΓ.

Inductive FindMethodWithName : class_table -> class_name -> method_name -> method_def -> Prop :=

  | FOM_Here : forall CT C def own_methods m mdef
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hget_method : gget_method own_methods m = Some mdef),
      FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef


  | FOM_Super : forall CT C def parent m mdef own_methods
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hnot_here   : gget_method own_methods m = None)
      (Hsuper      : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_fmn : FindMethodWithName CT parent m mdef),
      FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef.

Inductive expr_has_type : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> expr -> qualified_type -> Prop :=


  | ET_Null : forall CT Γ mt q class_name
      (Hwf  : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hdom : class_name < dom CT),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt ENull (Build_qualified_type q class_name)


  | ET_Var : forall CT Γ mt x T
      (Hwf  : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget : static_getType Γ x = Some T),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EVar x) T


  | ET_Field_abstract_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = AbstractState \/ mt = ConcreteState),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EField x f)
        (Build_qualified_type
          (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
          (f_base_type (ftype fDef)))


  | ET_Field_readonly_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EField x f)
        (Build_qualified_type
          (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
          (f_base_type (ftype fDef)))
.

Definition qc2q (qi : q_c) : q :=
  match qi with
    | RDM_c => RDM
    | Imm_c => Imm
    | Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_param (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition vpa_mutability_override (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition method_override_compatible
    (CT : class_table) (qc : q_c)
    (overrider overridden : method_sig) : Prop :=
  mname overrider = mname overridden /\
  mscope overrider = mscope overridden /\
  qualified_type_subtype CT
    (mret overrider)
    (vpa_mutability_override qc (mret overridden)) /\
  Forall2
    (fun overridden_param overrider_param =>
      qualified_type_subtype CT
        (vpa_mutability_override qc overridden_param)
        overrider_param)
    (mparams overridden) (mparams overrider) /\
  q_subtype
    (sqtype (vpa_mutability_override qc (mreceiver overridden)))
    (sqtype (mreceiver overrider)).

Inductive method_signature_refinement
    (CT : class_table) : method_sig -> method_sig -> Prop :=
  | msr_refl : forall msig,
      method_signature_refinement CT msig msig
  | msr_override : forall qc overrider overridden,
      bound CT (sctype (mreceiver overrider)) = Some qc ->
      base_subtype CT
        (sctype (mreceiver overrider))
        (sctype (mreceiver overridden)) ->
      wf_senv CT (mreceiver overrider :: mparams overrider) ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc overrider overridden ->
      method_signature_refinement CT overrider overridden
  | msr_trans : forall child middle parent,
      method_signature_refinement CT child middle ->
      method_signature_refinement CT middle parent ->
      method_signature_refinement CT child parent.

Definition is_nonmutable_qualifier (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RO \/ qualifier = Lost \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Imm.

Definition signature_has_no_mutable_roots (msig : method_sig) : Prop :=
  is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype (mreceiver msig)) /\
  Forall
    (fun T => is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype T))
    (mparams msig).

Definition get_this_qualified_type (sΓ : s_env) : option qualified_type :=
  match sΓ with
  | [] => None
  | T_this :: _ =>
      Some T_this
  end.

Inductive stmt_typing : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> stmt -> s_env -> Prop :=

  | ST_Skip : forall CT sΓ mt
      (Hwf : wf_senv CT sΓ),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt SSkip sΓ


  | ST_Local : forall CT sΓ mt T x sΓ'
      (Hwf       : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hwf_T     : wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T))
      (Hnone     : static_getType sΓ x = None)
      (Henv'     : sΓ' = sΓ ++ [T])
      (Hget_x    : static_getType sΓ' x = Some T),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SLocal T x) sΓ'


  | ST_VarAss : forall CT sΓ mt x e Te Tthis Tx
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Htype_e  : expr_has_type CT sΓ mt e Te)
      (Hthis    : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hnot_rcv : x <> 0)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hsub     : qualified_type_subtype CT Te Tx),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SVarAss x e) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_abstract_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ AbstractState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_concrete_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ ConcreteState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_readonly_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ ReadonlyState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_transitive_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | S_New : forall CT sΓ mt x Tx (qc:q_c) C args argtypes Tthis consig
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_args   : static_getType_list sΓ args = Some argtypes)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hconsig     : constructor_sig_lookup CT C = Some consig)
      (Hnot_rcv    : x <> 0)
      (Hqc         : vpa_mutability_bound (qc2q qc) (cqualifier consig) = qc2q qc)
      (Harg_sub    : Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg T)
                       argtypes (map (vpa_mutability_constructor_param qc) consig.(cparams)))
      (Hresult_sub : qualified_type_subtype CT (Build_qualified_type (qc2q qc) C) Tx),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SNew x qc C args) sΓ


  | ST_Call : forall CT sΓ mt x m y args argtypes Tthis Tx Ty mdef
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hget_args   : static_getType_list sΓ args = Some argtypes)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfind_m     : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) m mdef)
      (Hnot_rcv    : x <> 0)
      (Hret_sub    : qualified_type_subtype CT (vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state Ty (mret (msignature mdef))) Tx)
      (Hrcv_sub    : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state Ty
                         (mreceiver (msignature mdef)))
                     \/ (sqtype Ty = RO /\
                         mdef.(msignature).(mreceiver).(sqtype) = RDM /\
                         base_subtype CT (sctype Ty)
                           mdef.(msignature).(mreceiver).(sctype)))
      (Harg_sub    : Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg (vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state Ty T))
                       argtypes (mparams (msignature mdef)))
      (Hscope      : mt = AbstractState \/
                     (mt = ConcreteState /\ method_scope_subtype mdef.(msignature).(mscope) ConcreteState)),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SCall x m y args) sΓ


  | ST_Call_readonly_state : forall CT sΓ mt x m y args argtypes Tthis Tx Ty mdef
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hget_args   : static_getType_list sΓ args = Some argtypes)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfind_m     : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) m mdef)
      (Hnot_rcv    : x <> 0)
      (Hmt_not_abs : mdef.(msignature).(mscope) <> AbstractState)
      (Hmt_not_cs  : mdef.(msignature).(mscope) <> ConcreteState)
      (Hret_sub    : qualified_type_subtype CT (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty (mret (msignature mdef))) Tx)
      (Hrcv_sub    : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty
                         (mreceiver (msignature mdef)))
                     \/ (sqtype Ty = RO /\
                         mdef.(msignature).(mreceiver).(sqtype) = RDM /\

      (Harg_sub    : Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty T))
                       argtypes (mparams (msignature mdef)))
      (Hmt_not_abs2 : mt <> AbstractState)
      (Hmt_not_cs2  : mt <> ConcreteState)
      (Hmt_sub     : method_scope_subtype mdef.(msignature).(mscope) mt),

  | ST_Seq : forall CT sΓ mt s1 sΓ' s2 sΓ''
      (Hwf    : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Htype1 : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt s1 sΓ')
      (Htype2 : stmt_typing CT sΓ' mt s2 sΓ''),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SSeq s1 s2) sΓ''
.

Definition wf_constructor_object (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (ctor : constructor_def) : Prop :=
  parent_lookup CT C = None /\
  constructor_def_lookup CT C = Some ctor /\
  let sig := csignature ctor in
  let q_c := cqualifier sig in
  Some q_c = bound CT C /\
  cparams sig = [] /\
  CollectFields CT C [].

Definition wf_constructor (CT : class_table) (c : class_name) (ctor : constructor_sig) : Prop :=

  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier ctor) /\


  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) (cparams ctor) /\


  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\


  Forall2 (fun param_type field_def =>
    qualified_type_subtype CT
      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier ctor) param_type)
      {| sqtype := vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (cqualifier ctor) (mutability (ftype field_def));
         sctype := f_base_type (ftype field_def) |})
    (cparams ctor) field_defs.

Definition wf_method (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (mdef : method_def) : Prop :=
  let mscope := mdef.(msignature).(mscope) in
  let msig := msignature mdef in
  let methodbody := mbody mdef in
  let mbodystmt := mbody_stmt methodbody in
  let sΓ := msig.(mreceiver) :: msig.(mparams) in
  wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype (mret msig)) (sctype (mret msig)) /\
  exists sΓ' mbodyrettype,
    stmt_typing CT sΓ mscope mbodystmt sΓ' /\
    let mbodyretvar := mreturn methodbody in
    mbodyretvar < dom sΓ' /\
    nth_error sΓ' mbodyretvar = Some mbodyrettype /\
    qualified_type_subtype CT mbodyrettype (mret msig) /\
    (forall parent_def parent mdef_parent qc,
      find_class CT C = Some parent_def ->
      super (signature parent_def) = Some parent ->
      bound CT C = Some qc ->
      FindMethodWithName CT parent (mname msig) mdef_parent ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc msig (msignature mdef_parent)) /\
    sctype (mreceiver msig) = C /\
    (readonly_state_method_scope mscope ->
      signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig).

Inductive wf_class : class_table -> class_def -> Prop :=


| WFObjectDef : forall CT cdef class_name
    (Hno_super    : cdef.(signature).(super) = None)
    (Hrdm         : cdef.(signature).(class_qualifier) = RDM_c)
    (Hno_fields   : cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields) = [])
    (Hno_methods  : cdef.(body).(methods) = [])
    (Hcname       : cdef.(signature).(cname) = class_name)
    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))
    (Hnodup       : NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) cdef.(body).(methods))),
    wf_class CT cdef


| WFOtherDef : forall CT cdef superC thisC
    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),
    let sig := cdef.(signature) in
    let bod := cdef.(body) in
    let C := cname sig in
    let qC := class_qualifier sig in
    (wf_constructor CT C (csignature (constructor bod)) /\
    Forall (wf_method CT C) (methods bod) /\
    NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) (methods bod)) /\
    match bound CT superC with
    | Some q_super =>
        exists fs, CollectFields CT C fs /\
        (qC = q_super \/ q_super = RDM_c) /\
        Forall (wf_field CT) fs
    | None =>
        CollectFields CT C []
    end) ->
    wf_class CT cdef
.

Definition wf_class_table (CT : class_table) : Prop :=
  let object_class_at_zero :=
    exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\
                    super (signature obj_def) = None in
  let non_object_classes_extend_object :=
    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  super (signature def) <> None in
  let class_name_matches_index :=
    forall i def, find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  cname (signature def) = i in
  Forall (wf_class CT) CT /\
  object_class_at_zero /\
  non_object_classes_extend_object /\
  class_name_matches_index.

Definition is_mut_or_ro (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = RO.

Definition is_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_concrete_or_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_mut_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_imm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = Bot.

Require Import Syntax Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Helpers.

From Stdlib Require String.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Inductive CollectFields : class_table -> class_name -> list field_def -> Prop :=

  | CF_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None),
      CollectFields CT C []


  | CF_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_fields own_fields
      (Hfind        : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper       : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_cf   : CollectFields CT parent parent_fields)
      (Hown_fields  : own_fields = Syntax.fields (body def)),
      CollectFields CT C (parent_fields ++ own_fields).

Inductive FieldLookup : class_table -> class_name -> var -> field_def -> Prop :=
  | FL_Found : forall CT C fields f fdef
      (Hcf  : CollectFields CT C fields)
      (Hget : gget fields f = Some fdef),
      FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_def_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

Definition sf_assignability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (a: a) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ assignability (ftype fdef) = a.

Definition sf_mutability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (qf: q_f) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ mutability (ftype fdef) = qf.

Definition constructor_def_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_def :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => Some (constructor (body def))
  | None => None
  end.

Definition constructor_sig_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_sig :=
  match constructor_def_lookup CT C with
  | Some ctor => Some (csignature ctor)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition eq_method_name (m1 m2 : method_name) : bool :=
  match m1, m2 with
  | n1, n2 => Nat.eqb n1 n2
  end.

Definition gget_method (methods : list method_def) (m : method_name) : option method_def :=
  find (fun mdef => eq_method_name (mname (msignature mdef)) m) methods.

Definition override (parent_methods own_methods : list method_def) : list method_def :=
  own_methods ++ filter (fun pmdef =>
    negb (existsb (fun omdef =>
      eq_method_name (mname (msignature pmdef)) (mname (msignature omdef)))
    own_methods)) parent_methods.

Inductive CollectMethods : class_table -> class_name -> list method_def -> Prop :=

  | CM_NotFound : forall CT C
      (Hnone : find_class CT C = None),
      CollectMethods CT C []


  | CM_Object : forall CT C def
      (Hfind  : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper : super (signature def) = None)
      (Hdom   : C < dom CT),
      CollectMethods CT C (methods (body def))


  | CM_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_methods own_methods merged
      (Hfind          : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hsuper         : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hdom_C         : C < dom CT)
      (Hdom_parent    : parent < dom CT)
      (Hordering      : cname (signature def) > parent)
      (Hparent_cm     : CollectMethods CT parent parent_methods)
      (Hown_methods   : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hmerged        : merged = override parent_methods own_methods),
      CollectMethods CT C merged.

Definition wf_stypeuse (CT : class_table) (q_use: q) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match bound CT c with
  | Some q_bound =>



                  q_subtype (vpa_mutability_bound q_use q_bound) q_use /\
                   c < dom CT
  | None => False
  end.

Definition qf2q (qf : q_f) : q :=
  match qf with
  | Mut_f => Mut
  | Imm_f => Imm
  | RDM_f => RDM
  | RO_f => RO
  end.

Definition wf_field (CT : class_table) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  wf_stypeuse CT (qf2q (mutability (ftype fdef)))
    (f_base_type (ftype fdef)).

Definition wf_senv (CT : class_table) (sΓ : s_env) : Prop :=

  dom sΓ > 0 /\
  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) sΓ.

Inductive FindMethodWithName : class_table -> class_name -> method_name -> method_def -> Prop :=

  | FOM_Here : forall CT C def own_methods m mdef
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hget_method : gget_method own_methods m = Some mdef),
      FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef


  | FOM_Super : forall CT C def parent m mdef own_methods
      (Hfind       : find_class CT C = Some def)
      (Hown        : own_methods = methods (body def))
      (Hnot_here   : gget_method own_methods m = None)
      (Hsuper      : super (signature def) = Some parent)
      (Hparent_fmn : FindMethodWithName CT parent m mdef),
      FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef.

Inductive expr_has_type : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> expr -> qualified_type -> Prop :=


  | ET_Null : forall CT Γ mt q class_name
      (Hwf  : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hdom : class_name < dom CT),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt ENull (Build_qualified_type q class_name)


  | ET_Var : forall CT Γ mt x T
      (Hwf  : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget : static_getType Γ x = Some T),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EVar x) T


  | ET_Field_abstract_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = AbstractState \/ mt = ConcreteState),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EField x f)
        (Build_qualified_type
          (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
          (f_base_type (ftype fDef)))


  | ET_Field_readonly_state : forall CT Γ mt x T fDef f
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT Γ)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType Γ x = Some T)
      (Hfld_def : sf_def_rel CT (sctype T) f fDef)
      (Hmt      : mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState),
      expr_has_type CT Γ mt (EField x f)
        (Build_qualified_type
          (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
          (f_base_type (ftype fDef)))
.

Definition qc2q (qi : q_c) : q :=
  match qi with
    | RDM_c => RDM
    | Imm_c => Imm
    | Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_param (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition vpa_mutability_override (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition method_override_compatible
    (CT : class_table) (qc : q_c)
    (overrider overridden : method_sig) : Prop :=
  mname overrider = mname overridden /\
  mscope overrider = mscope overridden /\
  qualified_type_subtype CT
    (mret overrider)
    (vpa_mutability_override qc (mret overridden)) /\
  Forall2
    (fun overridden_param overrider_param =>
      qualified_type_subtype CT
        (vpa_mutability_override qc overridden_param)
        overrider_param)
    (mparams overridden) (mparams overrider) /\
  q_subtype
    (sqtype (vpa_mutability_override qc (mreceiver overridden)))
    (sqtype (mreceiver overrider)).

Inductive method_signature_refinement
    (CT : class_table) : method_sig -> method_sig -> Prop :=
  | msr_refl : forall msig,
      method_signature_refinement CT msig msig
  | msr_override : forall qc overrider overridden,
      bound CT (sctype (mreceiver overrider)) = Some qc ->
      base_subtype CT
        (sctype (mreceiver overrider))
        (sctype (mreceiver overridden)) ->
      wf_senv CT (mreceiver overrider :: mparams overrider) ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc overrider overridden ->
      method_signature_refinement CT overrider overridden
  | msr_trans : forall child middle parent,
      method_signature_refinement CT child middle ->
      method_signature_refinement CT middle parent ->
      method_signature_refinement CT child parent.

Definition is_nonmutable_qualifier (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RO \/ qualifier = Lost \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Imm.

Definition signature_has_no_mutable_roots (msig : method_sig) : Prop :=
  is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype (mreceiver msig)) /\
  Forall
    (fun T => is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype T))
    (mparams msig).

Definition get_this_qualified_type (sΓ : s_env) : option qualified_type :=
  match sΓ with
  | [] => None
  | T_this :: _ =>
      Some T_this
  end.

Inductive stmt_typing : class_table -> s_env -> method_scope -> stmt -> s_env -> Prop :=

  | ST_Skip : forall CT sΓ mt
      (Hwf : wf_senv CT sΓ),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt SSkip sΓ


  | ST_Local : forall CT sΓ mt T x sΓ'
      (Hwf       : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hwf_T     : wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T))
      (Hnone     : static_getType sΓ x = None)
      (Henv'     : sΓ' = sΓ ++ [T])
      (Hget_x    : static_getType sΓ' x = Some T),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SLocal T x) sΓ'


  | ST_VarAss : forall CT sΓ mt x e Te Tthis Tx
      (Hwf      : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Htype_e  : expr_has_type CT sΓ mt e Te)
      (Hthis    : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hnot_rcv : x <> 0)
      (Hget_x   : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hsub     : qualified_type_subtype CT Te Tx),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SVarAss x e) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_abstract_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ AbstractState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_concrete_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ ConcreteState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_readonly_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ ReadonlyState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | ST_FldWrite_transitive_state : forall CT sΓ x f y Tx Ty Tthis fieldT a
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
                       (Build_qualified_type
                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))
      (Hassignable : vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a = Assignable),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState (SFldWrite x f y) sΓ


  | S_New : forall CT sΓ mt x Tx (qc:q_c) C args argtypes Tthis consig
      (Hwf         : wf_senv CT sΓ)
      (Hget_x      : static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx)
      (Hget_args   : static_getType_list sΓ args = Some argtypes)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hconsig     : constructor_sig_lookup CT C = Some consig)
      (Hnot_rcv    : x <> 0)
      (Hqc         : vpa_mutability_bound (qc2q qc) (cqualifier consig) = qc2q qc)

Definition wf_constructor_object (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (ctor : constructor_def) : Prop :=
  parent_lookup CT C = None /\
  constructor_def_lookup CT C = Some ctor /\
  let sig := csignature ctor in
  let q_c := cqualifier sig in
  Some q_c = bound CT C /\
  cparams sig = [] /\
  CollectFields CT C [].

Definition wf_constructor (CT : class_table) (c : class_name) (ctor : constructor_sig) : Prop :=

  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier ctor) /\


  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) (cparams ctor) /\


  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\


  Forall2 (fun param_type field_def =>
    qualified_type_subtype CT
      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier ctor) param_type)
      {| sqtype := vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (cqualifier ctor) (mutability (ftype field_def));
         sctype := f_base_type (ftype field_def) |})
    (cparams ctor) field_defs.

Definition wf_method (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (mdef : method_def) : Prop :=
  let mscope := mdef.(msignature).(mscope) in
  let msig := msignature mdef in
  let methodbody := mbody mdef in
  let mbodystmt := mbody_stmt methodbody in
  let sΓ := msig.(mreceiver) :: msig.(mparams) in
  wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype (mret msig)) (sctype (mret msig)) /\
  exists sΓ' mbodyrettype,
    stmt_typing CT sΓ mscope mbodystmt sΓ' /\
    let mbodyretvar := mreturn methodbody in
    mbodyretvar < dom sΓ' /\
    nth_error sΓ' mbodyretvar = Some mbodyrettype /\
    qualified_type_subtype CT mbodyrettype (mret msig) /\
    (forall parent_def parent mdef_parent qc,
      find_class CT C = Some parent_def ->
      super (signature parent_def) = Some parent ->
      bound CT C = Some qc ->
      FindMethodWithName CT parent (mname msig) mdef_parent ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc msig (msignature mdef_parent)) /\
    sctype (mreceiver msig) = C /\
    (readonly_state_method_scope mscope ->
      signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig).

Inductive wf_class : class_table -> class_def -> Prop :=


| WFObjectDef : forall CT cdef class_name
    (Hno_super    : cdef.(signature).(super) = None)
    (Hrdm         : cdef.(signature).(class_qualifier) = RDM_c)
    (Hno_fields   : cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields) = [])
    (Hno_methods  : cdef.(body).(methods) = [])
    (Hcname       : cdef.(signature).(cname) = class_name)
    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))
    (Hnodup       : NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) cdef.(body).(methods))),
    wf_class CT cdef


| WFOtherDef : forall CT cdef superC thisC
    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),
    let sig := cdef.(signature) in
    let bod := cdef.(body) in
    let C := cname sig in
    let qC := class_qualifier sig in
    (wf_constructor CT C (csignature (constructor bod)) /\
    Forall (wf_method CT C) (methods bod) /\
    NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) (methods bod)) /\
    match bound CT superC with
    | Some q_super =>
        exists fs, CollectFields CT C fs /\
        (qC = q_super \/ q_super = RDM_c) /\
        Forall (wf_field CT) fs
    | None =>
        CollectFields CT C []
    end) ->
    wf_class CT cdef
.

Definition wf_class_table (CT : class_table) : Prop :=
  let object_class_at_zero :=
    exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\
                    super (signature obj_def) = None in
  let non_object_classes_extend_object :=
    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  super (signature def) <> None in
  let class_name_matches_index :=
    forall i def, find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  cname (signature def) = i in
  Forall (wf_class CT) CT /\
  object_class_at_zero /\
  non_object_classes_extend_object /\
  class_name_matches_index.

Definition is_mut_or_ro (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = RO.

Definition is_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_concrete_or_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_mut_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_imm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = Bot.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Sets.Ensembles.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Bigstep Reachability.

(* ---------- basic list/nth lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma nth_error_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) n x, nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof. intros X l n x H. apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_cons_0 : forall {X} (x:X) xs, nth_error (x::xs) 0 = Some x.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma nth_error_cons_S : forall {X} (x:X) xs n, nth_error (x::xs) (S n) = nth_error xs n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_app1 : forall {X} (l1 l2:list X) n x, nth_error l1 n = Some x -> nth_error (l1++l2) n = Some x.
Proof. intros. apply nth_error_app1; [apply nth_error_Some_lt in H | ]; assumption. Qed.
Lemma nth_error_app2 : forall {X} (l1 l2:list X) n, nth_error (l1++l2) (length l1 + n) = nth_error l2 n.
Proof. intros. apply nth_error_app2. lia. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_length : forall {X} (l:list X) n, n >= length l -> nth_error l n = None.
Proof. intros. apply nth_error_None. lia. Qed.

(* mapM lookup *)
Lemma mapM_nth : forall {A B} (f:A->option B) l n x,
  nth_error (mapM f l) n = Some x ->
  exists a, nth_error l n = Some a /\ f a = Some x.
Proof.
  intros A B f l. induction l; intros n x H.
  - destruct n; simpl in H; discriminate.
  - destruct n; simpl in H.
    + simpl in H. destruct (f a) eqn:E; try discriminate. inversion H; subst. exists a; auto.
    + destruct (f a) eqn:Ea; simpl in H; try discriminate.
      destruct (mapM f l) eqn:Em; simpl in H; try discriminate.
      apply IHl in H. destruct H as [a' [H1 H2]]. exists a'; split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma mapM_length : forall {A B} (f:A->option B) l out, mapM f l = Some out -> length out = length l.
Proof. intros A B f l. induction l; intros out H; simpl in H.
  - inversion H; auto.
  - destruct (f a) eqn:E; simpl in H; try discriminate.
    destruct (mapM f l) eqn:E2; simpl in H; try discriminate. inversion H; subst. simpl. rewrite IHl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_nth : forall rΓ zs vals n v,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> nth_error vals n = Some v ->
  exists x, nth_error zs n = Some x /\ runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v.
Proof.
  intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H.
  exact (mapM_nth _ _ _ _ H).
Qed.

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_length : forall rΓ zs vals,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> length vals = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_nth : forall sΓ zs tys n T,
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some tys -> nth_error tys n = Some T ->
  exists x, nth_error zs n = Some x /\ static_getType sΓ x = Some T.
Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. exact (mapM_nth _ _ _ _ H). Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_length : forall sΓ zs tys,
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some tys -> length tys = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

(* Forall2 nth *)
Lemma Forall2_nth_Some : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n a,
  Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some a ->
  exists b, nth_error l2 n = Some b /\ R a b.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1. induction l1; intros l2 n a HF Hn.
  - destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.
  - destruct l2; simpl in HF; try discriminate. inversion HF; subst.
    destruct n; simpl in Hn.
    + inversion Hn; subst. exists b; auto.
    + eapply IHl1; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_Some_r : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n b,
  Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l2 n = Some b ->
  exists a, nth_error l1 n = Some a /\ R a b.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1. induction l1; intros l2 n b HF Hn.
  - destruct l2; simpl in HF; try discriminate. destruct n; simpl in Hn; discriminate.
  - destruct l2; simpl in HF; try discriminate. inversion HF; subst.
    destruct n; simpl in Hn.
    + inversion Hn; subst. exists a; auto.
    + eapply IHl1; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_length : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2, Forall2 R l1 l2 -> length l1 = length l2.
Proof. intros A B R l1 l2 H. induction H; auto. Qed.

(* update *)
Lemma update_length : forall {X} n (v:X) l, length (update n v l) = length l.
Proof. intros X n v l. induction l; destruct n; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma update_nth_same : forall {X} n (v:X) l, n < length l -> nth_error (update n v l) n = Some v.
Proof.
  intros X n v l. revert n. induction l; intros n H.
  - simpl. lia.
  - destruct n; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply IHl. simpl in H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma update_nth_diff : forall {X} n m (v:X) l, n <> m -> nth_error (update n v l) m = nth_error l m.
Proof.
  intros X n m v l. revert n m. induction l; intros n m H.
  - destruct n; destruct m; simpl; auto.
  - destruct n, m; simpl; auto.
    + discriminate.
    + apply IHl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma update_nth_other_value : forall {X} n m (v:X) l x,
  nth_error l m = Some x -> n <> m -> nth_error (update n v l) m = Some x.
Proof. intros. rewrite update_nth_diff; auto. Qed.

Lemma update_id : forall {X} n (v:X) l, nth_error l n = Some v -> update n v l = l.
Proof.
  intros X n v l. revert n. induction l; intros n H.
  - destruct n; simpl in H; discriminate.
  - destruct n; simpl.
    + inversion H; subst; auto.
    + rewrite IHz l. auto. auto.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_none : forall h l f v, runtime_getObj h l = None -> update_field h l f v = h.
Proof.
  intros h l f v H. unfold update_field. rewrite H. auto.

Lemma update_field_at : forall h l f v o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l =
  Some (mkObj (rt_type o) (update f v (fields_map o))).
Proof.

  unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_same. apply nth_error_Some_lt in H. lia.

Lemma update_field_other : forall h l l' f v, l <> l' ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l' = runtime_getObj h l'.
Proof.
  intros h l l' f v Hne. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_diff. auto.
  - reflexivity.

Lemma update_field_length : forall h l f v, length (update_field h l f v) = length h.
Proof.
  intros h l f v. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|]; [|reflexivity].
  unfold set_fields_map. apply update_length.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_target_rt : forall h l l' f v o o',

  - rewrite update_field_at in H' by exact H. inversion H'; auto.
  - rewrite update_field_other in H' by auto. rewrite H in H'. inversion H'; auto.

Proof.
  intros h l l' f v o o' Hne H' H.
  rewrite update_field_other in H' by auto. rewrite H in H'. inversion H'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_fields_at : forall h l f v o o',

  intros h l f v o o' H H'. rewrite update_field_at in H' by exact H. inversion H'; auto.

(* ---------------- field collection lemmas ---------------- *)
Lemma CollectFields_det : forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
  forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1. induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hnone in Hfind. discriminate.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. inversion Hfind0; subst. reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. inversion Hsuper0; subst.
    assert (Hp : parent_fields = parent_fields0) by (eapply IHH1; eauto). subst. reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hfind in Hfind0. inversion Hfind0; subst.
    rewrite Hsuper in Hsuper0. inversion Hsuper0; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det : forall CT C f fd1, FieldLookup CT C f fd1 ->
  forall fd2, FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 [fs1 HC1 Hg1] fd2 [fs2 HC2 Hg2].
  assert (fs1 = fs2) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst.
  rewrite Hg1 in Hg2. inversion Hg2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma find_class_some_eq : forall CT C d1 d2, find_class CT C = Some d1 -> find_class CT C = Some d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof. intros. rewrite H in H0. inversion H0; auto. Qed.

Lemma parent_lookup_find : forall CT C d, find_class CT C = Some d ->
  parent_lookup CT C = super (signature d).
Proof. intros. unfold parent_lookup. rewrite H. auto. Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_prefix : forall CT C D, base_subtype CT C D ->
  forall fsC, CollectFields CT C fsC -> forall fsD, CollectFields CT D fsD ->
  exists rest, fsC = fsD ++ rest.
Proof.
  intros CT C D H. induction H; intros fsC HC fsD HD.
  - exists []. rewrite (CollectFields_det CT C fsC HC fsD HD). rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
  - (* base_extends C D *)
    inversion HC; subst; clear HC.
    + rewrite Hnone in Hparent. unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hnone in Hparent. discriminate.
    + rewrite Hfind in Hparent. unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hfind in Hparent.
      simpl in Hparent. rewrite Hsuper in Hparent. discriminate.
    + rewrite Hfind in Hparent. unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hfind in Hparent.
      simpl in Hparent. rewrite Hsuper in Hparent. inversion Hparent; subst.
      assert (Hpeq : parent_fields = fsD) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst.
      exists own_fields. assumption.
  - (* base_trans C D E *)
    edestruct IHH1 as [r1 Hr1]; eauto.
    edestruct IHH2 as [r2 Hr2]; eauto.
    exists (r2 ++ r1). rewrite Hr1, Hr2. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_index : forall CT C D f fd,
  base_subtype CT C D -> FieldLookup CT D f fd ->
  forall fsC, CollectFields CT C fsC -> nth_error fsC f = Some fd.
Proof.
  intros CT C D f fd Hsub [fsD HD Hg] fsC HC.
  edestruct (CollectFields_prefix CT C D Hsub fsC HC fsD HD) as [rest Heq]. subst.
  rewrite nth_error_app1. exact Hg. apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hg. lia.
Qed.

(* ---------------- wf_class_table extraction ---------------- *)
Definition find_class_in : forall CT C d, find_class CT C = Some d -> In d CT.
Proof. intros CT C d H. unfold find_class in H. eapply nth_error_In; eauto. Defined.

Lemma wf_class_table_Forall : forall CT, wf_class_table CT -> Forall (wf_class CT) CT.
Proof. intros CT H. unfold wf_class_table in H. destruct H as [H _]; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_class_table_cname : forall CT C d, wf_class_table CT -> find_class CT C = Some d ->
  cname (signature d) = C.
Proof.
  intros CT C d Hwf Hfind. unfold wf_class_table in Hwf.
  destruct Hwf as [_ [_ [_ Hcni]]]. eapply Hcni; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_class_table_object_zero : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\ super (signature obj_def) = None.
Proof. intros CT H. unfold wf_class_table in H. tauto. Qed.

(* methods of a well-formed class are wf *)
Lemma wf_class_methods : forall CT C d, wf_class_table CT -> find_class CT C = Some d ->
  (forall mdef, In mdef (methods (body d)) -> wf_method CT (cname (signature d)) mdef) /\
  (methods (body d) = [] \/ exists sc, super (signature d) = Some sc).
Proof.

  rewrite Forall_forall in Hall. pose proof (Hall d Hin) as Hwc. clear Hall.

    + intros mdef Hm. rewrite Hnm in Hm. inversion Hm.

  - split.
    + intros mdef Hm. destruct Hbody as [Hctor [Hmeth _]].
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hmeth. apply Hmeth. auto.
    + right. eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma gget_method_In : forall methods m mdef, gget_method methods m = Some mdef -> In mdef methods.
Proof. intros. unfold gget_method in H. apply find_some in H. tauto. Qed.

(* wf_method for the method found by FindMethodWithName *)
Lemma find_method_wf : forall CT C m mdef, wf_class_table CT ->
  FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef -> wf_method CT (sctype (mreceiver (msignature mdef))) mdef.
Proof.

(* ---------------- transitive-state invariant: heap-global safety ---------------- *)
Definition view (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (q : q) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = q /\ runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition heap_type_ok (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  forall fdefs, CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
    length (fields_map o) = length fdefs /\
    forall g fdef, nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      forall v, getVal (fields_map o) g = Some v ->
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot l' => exists rqt, r_type h l' = Some rqt /\
                     base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef))
        end.

Inductive mut_edge (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_edge_intro : forall l0 l1 o fdefs g fdef,
      runtime_getObj h l0 = Some o ->
      CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
      nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f) ->
      getVal (fields_map o) g = Some (Iot l1) ->
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1.

Inductive mut_reach (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_reach_nil : forall l, mut_reach CT h l l
  | mut_reach_cons : forall l0 l1 l2,
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1 -> mut_reach CT h l1 l2 -> mut_reach CT h l0 l2.

Lemma mut_reach_trans : forall CT h a b c,
  mut_reach CT h a b -> mut_reach CT h b c -> mut_reach CT h a c.
Proof.
  intros CT h a b c H. revert c. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - eapply mut_reach_cons; eauto.
Qed.

Definition safe_core (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  h0 <= l /\ exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.

Definition safe (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  safe_core h0 h l /\ forall l', mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe_core h0 h l'.

Lemma safe_core_safe : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe_core h0 h l.
Proof. intros; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_ge : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> h0 <= l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_obj : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l ->
  exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_reach : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h l l' [Hc Hcl] Hr. split.
  - apply Hcl; exact Hr.
  - intros l'' Hr''. apply Hcl. eapply mut_reach_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_step : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_edge CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof. intros. eapply safe_reach; eauto. apply mut_reach_cons with (l1:=l'); auto. apply mut_reach_nil. Qed.

Record Inv (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (E : option nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) : Prop := {
  inv_wfct : wf_class_table CT;
  inv_len : length sΓ = length rΓ.(vars);
  inv_wfsenv : wf_senv CT sΓ;
  inv_class_dom : forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o -> rctype (rt_type o) < dom CT;
  inv_agree : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype T);
  inv_bot : forall i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Bot ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some Null_a;
  inv_mut_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Mut ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) -> safe CT h0 h l;
  inv_rdm_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = RDM ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      match E with Some _ => safe CT h0 h l | None => True end;
  inv_htype : heap_type_ok CT h;
}.

Lemma r_type_some_lt : forall h l rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt -> l < dom h.
Proof.
  intros h l rqt H. unfold r_type in H.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
  apply nth_error_Some_lt in E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma stype_fld_ro_bot : forall q mut, vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state q mut = Bot -> q = Bot.
Proof. intros q mut H. destruct q, mut; simpl in *; try discriminate; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_runtime_class : forall CT h l o, wf_class_table CT ->
  runtime_getObj h l = Some o -> rctype (rt_type o) < dom CT ->
  exists fdefs, CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs.
Proof.
  intros CT h l o Hwf Hobj Hdom.
  destruct (find_class_of_lt CT (rctype (rt_type o)) Hdom) as [d Hd].
  eapply CollectFields_exists; eauto.
Qed.
EOF

(* ---------- basic list/nth lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma nth_error_Some_lt : forall {X} (l : list X) n x, nth_error l n = Some x -> n < length l.
Proof. intros X l n x H. apply nth_error_Some. rewrite H. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_cons_0 : forall {X} (x:X) xs, nth_error (x::xs) 0 = Some x.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma nth_error_cons_S : forall {X} (x:X) xs n, nth_error (x::xs) (S n) = nth_error xs n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_app1 : forall {X} (l1 l2:list X) n x, nth_error l1 n = Some x -> nth_error (l1++l2) n = Some x.
Proof. intros. rewrite nth_error_app1; auto. apply nth_error_Some_lt in H. lia. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_length : forall {X} (l:list X) n, n >= length l -> nth_error l n = None.
Proof. intros. apply nth_error_None. lia. Qed.

(* mapM lookup *)
Lemma mapM_nth : forall {A B} (f:A->option B) l out n x,
  mapM f l = Some out -> nth_error out n = Some x ->
  exists a, nth_error l n = Some a /\ f a = Some x.
Proof.
  intros A B f l. induction l as [|a l IH]; intros out n x H Ho.
  - simpl in H. inversion H; subst. destruct n; simpl in Ho; discriminate.
  - simpl in H. destruct (f a) as [y|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    destruct (mapM f l) as [ys|] eqn:E2; try discriminate.
    inversion H; subst. destruct n as [|n]; simpl in Ho.
    + inversion Ho; subst. exists a; auto.
    + edestruct (IH ys n x eq_refl Ho) as [a' [H1 H2]]. exists a'; simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma mapM_length : forall {A B} (f:A->option B) l out, mapM f l = Some out -> length out = length l.
Proof. intros A B f l. induction l; intros out H; simpl in H.
  - inversion H; auto.
  - destruct (f a) as [y|] eqn:E; try discriminate.
    destruct (mapM f l) as [ys|] eqn:E2; try discriminate.
    inversion H; subst. simpl. rewrite IHl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_nth : forall rΓ zs vals n v,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> nth_error vals n = Some v ->
  exists x, nth_error zs n = Some x /\ runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v.
Proof.
  intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H. eapply mapM_nth; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_length : forall rΓ zs vals,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> length vals = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_nth : forall sΓ zs tys n T,

Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. eapply mapM_nth; eauto. Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_length : forall sΓ zs tys,
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some tys -> length tys = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

(* Forall2 nth *)
Lemma Forall2_nth_Some : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n a0,
  Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some a0 ->
  exists b, nth_error l2 n = Some b /\ R a0 b.
Proof.

  induction n as [|n IH]; intros l1 l2 a HF Hn.

    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].

  - destruct l1 as [|x1 xs].
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys]; [simpl in Hn; discriminate|].
      simpl in Hn; discriminate.
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
      * simpl in Hn. rewrite Forall2_cons_iff in HF. destruct HF as [_ HFr].
        edestruct (IH xs ys a HFr) as [b [H1 H2]]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_Some_r : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n b0,

(* update *)
Lemma update_length : forall {X} n (v:X) l, length (update n v l) = length l.
Proof. intros X n v l. revert n. induction l as [|a l IH]; intros [|n]; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma update_nth_same : forall {X} n (v:X) l, n < length l -> nth_error (update n v l) n = Some v.
Proof.
  intros X n v l. revert n. induction l as [|a l IH]; intros [|n] H; simpl in *.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma update_nth_diff : forall {X} n m (v:X) l, n <> m -> nth_error (update n v l) m = nth_error l m.
Proof.
  intros X n m v l. revert n m. induction l as [|a l IH]; intros [|n] [|m] H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply H; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma update_nth_other_value : forall {X} n m (v:X) l x,
  nth_error l m = Some x -> n <> m -> nth_error (update n v l) m = Some x.
Proof. intros. rewrite update_nth_diff; auto. Qed.

Lemma update_id : forall {X} n (v:X) l, nth_error l n = Some v -> update n v l = l.
Proof.
  intros X n v l. revert n. induction l; intros n H.
  - destruct n; simpl in H; discriminate.
  - destruct n; simpl.
    + inversion H; subst; auto.
    + rewrite IHl; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------------- heap / object lemmas ---------------- *)
Lemma update_field_none : forall h l f v, runtime_getObj h l = None -> update_field h l f v = h.
Proof.
  intros h l f v H. unfold update_field. rewrite H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_at : forall h l f v o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l =
  Some (mkObj (rt_type o) (update f v (fields_map o))).
Proof.
  intros h l f v o H. unfold update_field. rewrite H.
  unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_same. apply nth_error_Some_lt in H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_other : forall h l l' f v, l <> l' ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l' = runtime_getObj h l'.
Proof.
  intros h l l' f v Hne. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_diff. auto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_length : forall h l f v, length (update_field h l f v) = length h.

  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|]; [|reflexivity].

Proof.

  destruct (Nat.eq_dec l l') as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l'. rewrite (update_field_at h l f v o H) in H'. inversion H'; auto.

Proof.
  intros h l l' f v o o' Hne H' H.
  rewrite (update_field_other h l l' f v Hne) in H'. rewrite H in H'. inversion H'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_fields_at : forall h l f v o o',

Proof.

Qed.

  intros l H. apply P1 in H. destruct H as [o Ho]. apply P2. apply nth_error_Some_lt in Ho. lia.

(* ---------------- transitive-state invariant: heap-global safety ---------------- *)
Definition view (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (q : q) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = q /\ runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition heap_type_ok (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  forall fdefs, CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
    length (fields_map o) = length fdefs /\
    forall g fdef, nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      forall v, getVal (fields_map o) g = Some v ->
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot l' => exists rqt, r_type h l' = Some rqt /\
                     base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef))
        end.

Inductive mut_edge (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_edge_intro : forall l0 l1 o fdefs g fdef,
      runtime_getObj h l0 = Some o ->
      CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
      nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f) ->
      getVal (fields_map o) g = Some (Iot l1) ->
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1.

Inductive mut_reach (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_reach_nil : forall l, mut_reach CT h l l
  | mut_reach_cons : forall l0 l1 l2,
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1 -> mut_reach CT h l1 l2 -> mut_reach CT h l0 l2.

Lemma mut_reach_trans : forall CT h a b c,
  mut_reach CT h a b -> mut_reach CT h b c -> mut_reach CT h a c.
Proof.
  intros CT h a b c H. revert c. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - eapply mut_reach_cons; eauto.
Qed.

Definition safe_core (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  h0 <= l /\ exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.

Definition safe (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  safe_core h0 h l /\ forall l', mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe_core h0 h l'.

Lemma safe_core_safe : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe_core h0 h l.
Proof. intros; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_ge : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> h0 <= l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_obj : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l ->
  exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; apply H. Qed.

Lemma safe_reach : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h l l' [Hc Hcl] Hr. split.
  - apply Hcl; exact Hr.
  - intros l'' Hr''. apply Hcl. eapply mut_reach_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_step : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_edge CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof. intros. eapply safe_reach; eauto. apply mut_reach_cons with (l1:=l'); auto. apply mut_reach_nil. Qed.

  inv_wfct : wf_class_table CT;

  inv_mut_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Mut ->

  inv_rdm_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = RDM ->

Definition write_field_cond (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (lx g : nat) : Prop :=
  exists o fdefs fdef,
    runtime_getObj h lx = Some o /\
    CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs /\
    nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef /\
    (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f).

Lemma update_nth_get_same : forall {X} n (v:X) l x, nth_error (update n v l) n = Some x -> x = v.
Proof.
  intros X n v l x. revert n. induction l as [|a l IH]; intros [|n] H; simpl in *.
  - discriminate.
  - discriminate.
  - inversion H; auto.
  - eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mut_edge_update_field : forall CT h lx g vv a b,
  mut_edge CT (update_field h lx g vv) a b ->
  mut_edge CT h a b \/
  (a = lx /\ write_field_cond CT h lx g /\ vv = Iot b).
Proof.
  intros CT h lx g vv a b H. inversion H as [o' fdefs g' fdef Hobj' HCF Hnth Hmut Hget']; subst; clear H.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec a lx) as [Heq|Hne].

    destruct (runtime_getObj h lx) as [o|] eqn:Eo.
    + rewrite (update_field_at h lx g vv o Eo) in Hobj'.

      * left. eapply mut_edge_intro; eauto.

    + rewrite (update_field_none h lx g vv Eo) in Hobj'.
      left. eapply mut_edge_intro; eauto.
  - left. eapply mut_edge_intro; eauto.
    + rewrite (update_field_other h lx a g vv Hne) in Hobj'. exact Hobj'.
    + (* fields_map unchanged *)
      destruct (runtime_getObj h lx) as [ox|] eqn:Eo.
      * destruct (runtime_getObj h a) as [oa|] eqn:Ea.

    + exact Hmut.
