Lemma stmt_preserve_gen : forall CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h',
  eval_stmt CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' ->
  forall h0 E sΓ sΓ' (Hty : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState s sΓ'),
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  res = OK ->
  Inv CT h0 E h' sΓ' rΓ' /\
  (forall l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe CT h0 h' l) /\
  (forall l, l < h0 -> runtime_getObj h' l = runtime_getObj h l).
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' He.
  induction He; intros h0 E sΓ sΓ' Hty HI Hres.
  - (* SBS_Skip *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty. split; [exact HI|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Local *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    split; [eapply inv_local_append; eauto|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    assert (HA : forall l, v2 = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
              base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Tx)).
    { intros l Hl. edestruct (expr_agree CT sΓ' h0 E h rΓ e Te TransitiveState v2 Htype_e (or_intror eq_refl) Heval HI l Hl) as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|]. eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs | apply qualified_type_subtype_base; exact Hsub]. }
    assert (HB : sqtype Tx = Bot -> v2 = Null_a).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HM : sqtype Tx = Mut -> v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l)).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_mut_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - left. eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HR : sqtype Tx = RDM ->
              match E with Some _ => v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l) | None => True end).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_rdm_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - destruct E as [ee|]; [|exact I]. left.
        eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    split.
    + eapply inv_update_var; eauto.
    + split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite *) admit.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_New *) admit.
  - (* SBS_Call *) admit.
  - (* SBS_Call_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Call_NPE_Body *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Call_MUTATIONEXP_Body *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    edestruct (IHHeval1 h0 E sΓ sΓ0 Htype1 HI eq_refl) as [HI1 [Hsafe1 Hagree1]].
    edestruct (IHHeval2 h0 E sΓ0 sΓ' Htype2 HI1 eq_refl) as [HI2 [Hsafe2 Hagree2]].
    split; [exact HI2|]. split.
    + intros l Hl. apply Hsafe2, Hsafe1, Hl.
    + intros l Hl. rewrite Hagree2 by exact Hl. apply Hagree1; exact Hl.
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_first *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_second *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_first *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_second *) discriminate Hres.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_map_some : forall {A B} (f:A->B) l n b,
  nth_error (map f l) n = Some b -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a /\ f a = b.
Proof.
  intros A B f l n b H. rewrite nth_error_map in H.
  destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
  simpl in H. inversion H; subst. exists a; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_exists_lt : forall {A} (l:list A) n, n < length l -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a.
Proof. intros A l n H. destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [exists a; auto|].

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l

      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=

Inductive CollectFields : class_table -> class_name -> list field_def -> Prop :=

  | CF_NotFound : forall CT C

  | CF_Object : forall CT C def

  | CF_Inherit : forall CT C def parent parent_fields own_fields
      (Hfind        : find_class CT C = Some def)

      (Hparent_cf   : CollectFields CT parent parent_fields)
      (Hown_fields  : own_fields = Syntax.fields (body def)),

Inductive FieldLookup : class_table -> class_name -> var -> field_def -> Prop :=
  | FL_Found : forall CT C fields f fdef

Definition sf_def_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (fdef: field_def) : Prop :=
  FieldLookup CT C f fdef.

  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ assignability (ftype fdef) = a.

Definition sf_mutability_rel (CT: class_table) (C: class_name) (f: var) (qf: q_f) : Prop :=
  exists fdef, FieldLookup CT C f fdef /\ mutability (ftype fdef) = qf.

Definition constructor_def_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_def :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some def => Some (constructor (body def))
  | None => None
  end.

Definition constructor_sig_lookup (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option constructor_sig :=
  match constructor_def_lookup CT C with
  | Some ctor => Some (csignature ctor)
  | None => None
  end.

Definition eq_method_name (m1 m2 : method_name) : bool :=
  match m1, m2 with
  | n1, n2 => Nat.eqb n1 n2
  end.

Definition gget_method (methods : list method_def) (m : method_name) : option method_def :=
  find (fun mdef => eq_method_name (mname (msignature mdef)) m) methods.

    negb (existsb (fun omdef =>

  cparams sig = [] /\

  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

From Stdlib Require String.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Typing Subtyping ViewpointAdaptation Helpers Reachability.

Definition get_this_var_mapping (vm : var_mapping) : option Loc :=
  match vm with
  | [] => None
  | ι :: _ =>
    match ι with
    | Null_a => None
    | Iot loc => Some loc
    end
  end.

Definition r_muttype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option q_r :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rqtype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_basetype (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option class_name :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rctype (rt_type o))
  end.

Definition r_type (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : option runtime_type :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => None
  | Some o => Some (rt_type o)
  end.

Definition update_field (h: heap) (ι: Loc) (f: var) (v: value) : heap :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => h
  | Some o =>
      let new_fields := update f v o.(fields_map) in
      let new_obj := (set_fields_map o (new_fields))
      in update ι new_obj h
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : bool :=
  match (q1, q2) with
    | (Imm_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Imm_r, Imm_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, Mut_c) => true
    | (_, _) => false
    end.

Definition wf_rtypeuse (CT: class_table) (q: q_r) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match (bound CT c) with
  | None => False
  | Some q' => c < dom CT /\ vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree q q'
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_context (qr: q_r) (qs: q) (qcontext: q_r): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_heap (qr: q_r) (qs: q): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition wf_obj (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : Prop :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => False
  | Some o =>

      wf_rtypeuse CT (rt_type o).(rqtype) (rt_type o).(rctype) /\

      exists field_defs, CollectFields CT (rt_type o).(rctype) field_defs /\
      List.length (fields_map o) = List.length field_defs /\
      Forall2 (fun v fdef =>
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot loc =>
          match runtime_getObj h loc with
          | Some _ =>

            exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\
            base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef)) /\
            qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt) (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
          | None => False
          end
        end) (fields_map o) field_defs
  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

Inductive eval_result :=
| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Val : forall CT rΓ h x v
      (Hval : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EVar x) v OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field : forall CT rΓ h x f v o v1
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot v))
      (Hobj   : runtime_getObj h v = Some o)
      (Hfield : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some v1),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) v1 OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) Null_a NPE rΓ h
  .

Inductive eval_stmt : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> stmt -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | SBS_Skip : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h SSkip OK rΓ h


  | SBS_Local : forall CT rΓ h T x
      (Hnone : runtime_getVal rΓ x = None),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SLocal T x) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (rΓ.(vars)++[Null_a]) )
      h


  | SBS_Assign : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 OK rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (update x v2 rΓ.(vars)))
      h

  | SBS_Assign_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 NPE rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) NPE
      rΓ
      h


  | SBS_FldWrite : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y h'
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hruntime_assignable : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable)
      (Hupdate : h' = update_field h loc_x f val_y),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) OK rΓ h'


  | SBS_FldWrite_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f y

      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hfinal  : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Final),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) MUTATIONEXP rΓ h


  | SBS_New : forall CT rΓ h x (q_c:q_c) c ys l1 qthisr vals o qadapted rΓ' h'
      (Hthis    : runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hargs    : runtime_lookup_list rΓ ys = Some vals)
      (Hmut     : r_muttype h l1 = Some qthisr)
      (Hadapt   : vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c = qadapted)
      (Hobj     : o = mkObj (mkruntime_type qadapted c) (vals))
      (Hheap    : h' = h++[o])
      (Henv     : rΓ' = (set_vars rΓ (update x (Iot (dom h)) rΓ.(vars)))),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SNew x q_c c ys) OK rΓ' h'


  | SBS_Call : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret retval h' rΓ' rΓ'' rΓ'''
      (Hval_y      : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase       : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind       : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt       : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret        : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs       : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe      : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))

      let new_obj := (set_fields_map o (new_fields))
      in update ι new_obj h
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree (q1: q_r)(q2 : q_c) : bool :=
  match (q1, q2) with
    | (Imm_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, RDM_c) => true
    | (Imm_r, Imm_c) => true
    | (Mut_r, Mut_c) => true
    | (_, _) => false
    end.

Definition wf_rtypeuse (CT: class_table) (q: q_r) (c: class_name) : Prop :=
  match (bound CT c) with
  | None => False
  | Some q' => c < dom CT /\ vpa_mutability_runtime_bound_agree q q'
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_context (qr: q_r) (qs: q) (qcontext: q_r): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match vpa_mutability_runtime qcontext qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | Lost => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition qualifier_typable_heap (qr: q_r) (qs: q): Prop :=
  match qr with
  | Imm_r =>
    match qs with
    | Imm => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  | Mut_r =>
    match qs with
    | Mut => True
    | RO => True
    | _ => False
    end
  end.

Definition wf_obj (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : Prop :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => False
  | Some o =>

      wf_rtypeuse CT (rt_type o).(rqtype) (rt_type o).(rctype) /\

      exists field_defs, CollectFields CT (rt_type o).(rctype) field_defs /\
      List.length (fields_map o) = List.length field_defs /\
      Forall2 (fun v fdef =>
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot loc =>
          match runtime_getObj h loc with
          | Some _ =>

            exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\
            base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef)) /\
            qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt) (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
          | None => False
          end
        end) (fields_map o) field_defs
  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

Inductive eval_result :=
| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Inductive eval_expr : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> expr -> value -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Val : forall CT rΓ h x v
      (Hval : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EVar x) v OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field : forall CT rΓ h x f v o v1
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot v))
      (Hobj   : runtime_getObj h v = Some o)
      (Hfield : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some v1),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) v1 OK rΓ h


  | EBS_Field_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_expr CT rΓ h (EField x f) Null_a NPE rΓ h
  .

Inductive eval_stmt : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> stmt -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | SBS_Skip : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h SSkip OK rΓ h


  | SBS_Local : forall CT rΓ h T x
      (Hnone : runtime_getVal rΓ x = None),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SLocal T x) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (rΓ.(vars)++[Null_a]) )
      h


  | SBS_Assign : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 OK rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) OK
      (set_vars rΓ (update x v2 rΓ.(vars)))
      h

  | SBS_Assign_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x e v1 v2
      (Hval   : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v1)
      (Heval  : eval_expr CT rΓ h e v2 NPE rΓ h),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SVarAss x e) NPE
      rΓ
      h


  | SBS_FldWrite : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y h'
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hruntime_assignable : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Assignable)
      (Hupdate : h' = update_field h loc_x f val_y),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) OK rΓ h'


  | SBS_FldWrite_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x f y
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP : forall CT rΓ h x f y loc_x o a vf val_y
      (Hval_x  : runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x))
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o)
      (Hfield  : getVal o.(fields_map) f = Some vf)
      (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a)
      (Hval_y  : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y)
      (Hfinal  : runtime_vpa_assignability (rqtype (rt_type o)) a = Final),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SFldWrite x f y) MUTATIONEXP rΓ h


  | SBS_New : forall CT rΓ h x (q_c:q_c) c ys l1 qthisr vals o qadapted rΓ' h'
      (Hthis    : runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hargs    : runtime_lookup_list rΓ ys = Some vals)
      (Hmut     : r_muttype h l1 = Some qthisr)
      (Hadapt   : vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c = qadapted)
      (Hobj     : o = mkObj (mkruntime_type qadapted c) (vals))
      (Hheap    : h' = h++[o])
      (Henv     : rΓ' = (set_vars rΓ (update x (Iot (dom h)) rΓ.(vars)))),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SNew x q_c c ys) OK rΓ' h'


  | SBS_Call : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret retval h' rΓ' rΓ'' rΓ'''
      (Hval_y      : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase       : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind       : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt       : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret        : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs       : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe      : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body  : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt OK rΓ'' h')
      (Hretval     : runtime_getVal rΓ'' mret = Some retval)
      (Henv        : rΓ''' = (set_vars rΓ (update x retval rΓ.(vars)))),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) OK rΓ''' h'


  | SBS_Call_NPE : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs
      (Hnull : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Null_a)),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) NPE rΓ h

  | SBS_Call_NPE_Body : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret h' rΓ' rΓ''
      (Hval_y     : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase      : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind      : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt      : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret       : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs      : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe     : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt NPE rΓ'' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) NPE rΓ'' h'

  | SBS_Call_MUTATIONEXP_Body : forall CT rΓ h x y m zs vals ly cy mdef mbody mstmt mret h' rΓ' rΓ''
      (Hval_y     : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
      (Hbase      : r_basetype h ly = Some cy)
      (Hfind      : FindMethodWithName CT cy m mdef /\ mbody = Syntax.mbody mdef)
      (Hstmt      : mstmt = mbody.(mbody_stmt))
      (Hret       : mret = mbody.(mreturn))
      (Hargs      : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
      (Hframe     : rΓ' = mkr_env (Iot ly :: vals))
      (Heval_body : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h mstmt MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SCall x m y zs) MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h'

  | SBS_Seq : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 OK rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) OK rΓ'' h''

  | SBS_Seq_NPE_first : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h'
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 NPE rΓ' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) NPE rΓ' h'

  | SBS_Seq_NPE_second : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 NPE rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) NPE rΓ'' h''

  | SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_first : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h'
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 MUTATIONEXP rΓ' h'),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) MUTATIONEXP rΓ' h'

  | SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_second : forall CT rΓ h s1 s2 rΓ' h' rΓ'' h''
      (Heval1 : eval_stmt CT rΓ h s1 OK rΓ' h')
      (Heval2 : eval_stmt CT rΓ' h' s2 MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h''),
      eval_stmt CT rΓ h (SSeq s1 s2) MUTATIONEXP rΓ'' h''
  .

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | Mut, Mut => Mut
    | _, Mut => Lost
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with






    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | Mut, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, Mut_f => Lost
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_assignability (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_assignability_cs_ts (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | Mut, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_bound (q1: q)(q2 : q_c) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_c => Lost
    | q1, RDM_c => q1
    | _, Imm_c => Imm
    | _, Mut_c => Mut
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (q1: q_c)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_c, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_c, RDM_f => Mut
    | RDM_c, RDM_f => RDM
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM_f => Mut
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM => Imm
    | Mut_r, RDM => Mut
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_r, RDM_c => Imm_r
    | Mut_r, RDM_c => Mut_r
    | _, Imm_c => Imm_r
    | _, Mut_c => Mut_r

=====SYNTAX=====
From Stdlib Require List.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Definition var : Type := nat.

Definition method_name : Type := nat.

Definition class_name : Type := nat.

Inductive q : Type :=

  | Mut
  | Imm
  | RDM

  | RO

  | Lost
  | Bot.

Inductive q_f : Type :=

  | Mut_f
  | Imm_f
  | RDM_f

  | RO_f.

Inductive q_c : Type :=

  | Mut_c
  | Imm_c
  | RDM_c.

Inductive a : Type :=
  | Assignable
  | Final
  | RDA.

Record qualified_type := {
  sqtype: q;
  sctype: class_name;
}.

Definition s_env := list qualified_type.

Inductive expr : Type :=
  | ENull : expr
  | EVar : var -> expr
  | EField : var -> var -> expr.

Inductive stmt: Type :=
  | SSkip: stmt
  | SLocal: qualified_type -> var -> stmt
  | SVarAss: var -> expr -> stmt
  | SFldWrite: var -> var -> var -> stmt
  | SNew: var -> q_c -> class_name -> list var -> stmt
  | SCall: var -> var -> method_name -> list var -> stmt

  | SSeq: stmt -> stmt -> stmt.

Record field_type := {
  assignability: a;
  mutability: q_f;
  f_base_type : class_name;
}.

Record field_def := {
  ftype : field_type;
  fname : var;
}.

Record constructor_body :={
  assignments: list (var * var);
}.

Record constructor_sig := {
  cqualifier: q_c;
  cparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record constructor_def := {
  csignature : constructor_sig;

}.

Record method_body := {
  mbody_stmt: stmt;
  mreturn: var;
}.

Inductive method_scope : Type :=
  | AbstractState
  | ConcreteState
  | ReadonlyState
  | TransitiveState.

Definition readonly_state_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Definition strict_assignability_method_scope (mt : method_scope) : Prop :=
  mt = ConcreteState \/ mt = TransitiveState.

Record method_sig := {
  mscope: method_scope;
  mret : qualified_type;
  mname : method_name;
  mreceiver: qualified_type;
  mparams : list qualified_type;
}.

Record method_def := {
  msignature : method_sig;
  mbody : method_body;
}.

Record class_body := {
  fields : list field_def;
  constructor: constructor_def;
  methods : list method_def;
}.

Record class_sig := {
  class_qualifier : q_c;
  cname : class_name;
  super : option class_name;
}.

Record class_def := {
  signature : class_sig;
  body : class_body;
}.

Record program_def := {
  classes: list class_def;
  main_statement: stmt;
}.

Definition class_table := list class_def.

Inductive q_r : Type :=
  | Mut_r
  | Imm_r
  .

Record runtime_type := mkruntime_type {
  rqtype: q_r;
  rctype: class_name;
}.

Definition Loc : Type := nat.

Inductive value : Type :=
  | Null_a : value
  | Iot: Loc -> value.

Definition var_mapping   := list value.

Record r_env := mkr_env {
  vars: var_mapping;
}.

Definition set_vars (_ : r_env) (vars' : var_mapping) : r_env :=
  mkr_env vars'.

Definition fields_mapping := list value.

Record Obj := mkObj {
  rt_type: runtime_type;
  fields_map: fields_mapping;
}.

Definition set_fields_map (o : Obj) (fields' : fields_mapping) : Obj :=
  mkObj (rt_type o) fields'.

Definition heap          := list Obj.

Require Export Syntax.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Require Export Notations.

Require Export ssreflect ssrbool Stdlib.Sets.Finite_sets_facts.

Definition gget {X: Type} (l : list X)  : Loc -> option X := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getObj (l : heap)    : Loc -> option Obj := nth_error l.

Definition getVal (l : list value)  : Loc -> option value := nth_error l.

Definition runtime_getVal (rΓ : r_env): Loc -> option value := nth_error (rΓ.(vars)).

Definition static_getType (sΓ: s_env): Loc -> option qualified_type := nth_error sΓ.

Fixpoint mapM {A B : Type} (f : A -> option B) (l : list A) : option (list B) :=
  match l with
  | [] => Some []
  | x :: xs =>
      match f x, mapM f xs with
      | Some y, Some ys => Some (y :: ys)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  end.

Definition static_getType_list (sΓ: s_env): list Loc -> option (list qualified_type) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => static_getType sΓ x) l.

Definition runtime_lookup_list (rΓ: r_env): list Loc -> option (list value) :=
  fun l => mapM (fun x => runtime_getVal rΓ x) l.

Fixpoint forallb2 {A B} (f : A -> B -> bool) (l1 : list A) (l2 : list B) : bool :=
  match l1, l2 with
  | [], [] => true
  | x1 :: xs1, x2 :: xs2 => f x1 x2 && forallb2 f xs1 xs2
  | _, _ => false
  end.

Fixpoint update {X : Type} (position : nat) (value : X) (l : list X) : list X :=
  match l, position with
  | [], _ => []
  | _::t, 0 => value :: t
  | h::l', S n => h :: update n value l'
  end.

Notation "[ x ↦  v ] l" := (update x v l) (at level 0).

Definition update_r_env_value (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (v : value) : r_env :=
  match rΓ with
  {| vars := vars; |} =>
      {| vars := update l v vars;|}
  end.

Definition find_class (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option class_def :=
    gget CT C.

Definition bound (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) : option q_c :=
  match find_class CT C with
  | Some decl => Some (class_qualifier (signature decl))
  | None => None
  end.

Definition wf_constructor_object (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (ctor : constructor_def) : Prop :=
  parent_lookup CT C = None /\
  constructor_def_lookup CT C = Some ctor /\
  let sig := csignature ctor in
  let q_c := cqualifier sig in
  Some q_c = bound CT C /\
  cparams sig = [] /\
  CollectFields CT C [].

Definition wf_constructor (CT : class_table) (c : class_name) (ctor : constructor_sig) : Prop :=

  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier ctor) /\


  Forall (fun T => wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype T) (sctype T)) (cparams ctor) /\


  exists field_defs,
    CollectFields CT c field_defs /\
    length (cparams ctor) = length field_defs /\


  Forall2 (fun param_type field_def =>
    qualified_type_subtype CT
      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier ctor) param_type)
      {| sqtype := vpa_mutability_constructor_fld (cqualifier ctor) (mutability (ftype field_def));
         sctype := f_base_type (ftype field_def) |})
    (cparams ctor) field_defs.

Definition wf_method (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (mdef : method_def) : Prop :=
  let mscope := mdef.(msignature).(mscope) in
  let msig := msignature mdef in
  let methodbody := mbody mdef in
  let mbodystmt := mbody_stmt methodbody in
  let sΓ := msig.(mreceiver) :: msig.(mparams) in
  wf_stypeuse CT (sqtype (mret msig)) (sctype (mret msig)) /\
  exists sΓ' mbodyrettype,
    stmt_typing CT sΓ mscope mbodystmt sΓ' /\
    let mbodyretvar := mreturn methodbody in
    mbodyretvar < dom sΓ' /\
    nth_error sΓ' mbodyretvar = Some mbodyrettype /\
    qualified_type_subtype CT mbodyrettype (mret msig) /\
    (forall parent_def parent mdef_parent qc,
      find_class CT C = Some parent_def ->
      super (signature parent_def) = Some parent ->
      bound CT C = Some qc ->
      FindMethodWithName CT parent (mname msig) mdef_parent ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc msig (msignature mdef_parent)) /\
    sctype (mreceiver msig) = C /\
    (readonly_state_method_scope mscope ->
      signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig).

Inductive wf_class : class_table -> class_def -> Prop :=


| WFObjectDef : forall CT cdef class_name
    (Hno_super    : cdef.(signature).(super) = None)
    (Hrdm         : cdef.(signature).(class_qualifier) = RDM_c)
    (Hno_fields   : cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields) = [])
    (Hno_methods  : cdef.(body).(methods) = [])
    (Hcname       : cdef.(signature).(cname) = class_name)
    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))
    (Hnodup       : NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) cdef.(body).(methods))),
    wf_class CT cdef


| WFOtherDef : forall CT cdef superC thisC
    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),
    let sig := cdef.(signature) in
    let bod := cdef.(body) in
    let C := cname sig in
    let qC := class_qualifier sig in
    (wf_constructor CT C (csignature (constructor bod)) /\
    Forall (wf_method CT C) (methods bod) /\
    NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) (methods bod)) /\
    match bound CT superC with
    | Some q_super =>
        exists fs, CollectFields CT C fs /\
        (qC = q_super \/ q_super = RDM_c) /\
        Forall (wf_field CT) fs
    | None =>
        CollectFields CT C []
    end) ->
    wf_class CT cdef
.

Definition wf_class_table (CT : class_table) : Prop :=
  let object_class_at_zero :=
    exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\
                    super (signature obj_def) = None in
  let non_object_classes_extend_object :=
    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  super (signature def) <> None in
  let class_name_matches_index :=
    forall i def, find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  cname (signature def) = i in
  Forall (wf_class CT) CT /\
  object_class_at_zero /\
  non_object_classes_extend_object /\
  class_name_matches_index.

Definition is_mut_or_ro (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = RO.

Definition is_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_concrete_or_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_mut_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_imm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = Bot.

  | method_rs_as : method_scope_subtype ReadonlyState AbstractState
  | method_ts_as : method_scope_subtype TransitiveState AbstractState

  | q_refl : forall q1
      (Hnot_lost : q1 <> Lost),
      q_subtype q1 q1
  | q_rd : forall q1,
      q_subtype q1 RO
  | q_bot : forall q1,
      q_subtype Bot q1
where "q1 ⊑ q2" := (q_subtype q1 q2).

  match find_class CT C with

  | base_refl : forall (CT : class_table) (C : class_name)

  | base_trans : forall (CT : class_table) (C D E : class_name)
      (Hsub1 : base_subtype CT C D)
      (Hsub2 : base_subtype CT D E),
      base_subtype CT C E
  | base_extends : forall (CT : class_table) (C D : class_name)
      (Hdom_C  : C < dom CT)

      (Hqsub  : q_subtype (sqtype qt1) (sqtype qt2))

      (Hsub12 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt2)
      (Hsub23 : qualified_type_subtype CT qt2 qt3),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt1 qt3
  | qtype_refl : forall CT qt
      (Hdom      : sctype qt < dom CT)
      (Hnot_lost : sqtype qt <> Lost),
      qualified_type_subtype CT qt qt.

Lemma nth_error_map_some : forall {A B} (f:A->B) l n b,
  nth_error (map f l) n = Some b -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a /\ f a = b.
Proof.
  intros A B f l n b H. rewrite nth_error_map in H.
  destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
  simpl in H. inversion H; subst. exists a; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_exists_lt : forall {A} (l:list A) n, n < length l -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a.
Proof. intros A l n H. destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [exists a; auto|].

Lemma nth_error_Some_eq : forall {A} (l:list A) n a b, nth_error l n = Some a -> nth_error l n = Some b -> a = b.

                (mutability (ftype fdef)) (f_base_type (ftype fdef))
                HI HgetT Hval' Hqc Hb Hb2 Hmut) as [Hnul | Hex].
  - discriminate Hnul.
  - destruct Hex as [lv [Heq Hsafe]]. inversion Heq; subst.
    split; [|exact Hsafe].
    destruct (inv_agree CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI yv T lv HgetT Hval') as [rqt [Hrt _]].
    eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma stmt_preserve_gen : forall CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h',
  eval_stmt CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' ->
  forall h0 E sΓ sΓ' (Hty : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState s sΓ'),
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  res = OK ->
  Inv CT h0 E h' sΓ' rΓ' /\
  (forall l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe CT h0 h' l) /\
  (forall l, l < h0 -> runtime_getObj h' l = runtime_getObj h l).
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' He.
  induction He; intros h0 E sΓ sΓ' Hty HI Hres.
  - (* SBS_Skip *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty. split; [exact HI|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Local *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    split; [eapply inv_local_append; eauto|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    assert (HA : forall l, v2 = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
              base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Tx)).
    { intros l Hl. edestruct (expr_agree CT sΓ' h0 E h rΓ e Te TransitiveState v2 Htype_e (or_intror eq_refl) Heval HI l Hl) as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|]. eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs | apply qualified_type_subtype_base; exact Hsub]. }
    assert (HB : sqtype Tx = Bot -> v2 = Null_a).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HM : sqtype Tx = Mut -> v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l)).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_mut_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - left. eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HR : sqtype Tx = RDM ->
              match E with Some _ => v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l) | None => True end).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_rdm_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - destruct E as [ee|]; [|exact I]. left.
        eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    split.
    + eapply inv_update_var; eauto.
    + split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite *) admit.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_FldWrite_MUTATIONEXP *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_New *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    assert (Hfind : exists def, find_class CT c = Some def).
    { unfold constructor_sig_lookup in Hconsig. unfold constructor_def_lookup in Hconsig.
      destruct (find_class CT c) as [def|] eqn:Eeq; [exists def; reflexivity|discriminate]. }
    destruct Hfind as [def Hfind].
    pose proof (class_constructor_facts CT c def consig (inv_wfct CT h0 E h sΓ' rΓ HI) Hfind Hconsig)
      as [Hbound [field_defs [HCF [Hlen2 HF2]]]].
    assert (Hclt : c < dom CT) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hfind; auto).
    assert (L1 : length vals = length ys) by (eapply runtime_lookup_list_length; eauto).
    assert (L2 : length argtypes = length ys) by (eapply static_getType_list_length; eauto).
    assert (L3 : length argtypes = length (cparams consig)).
    { pose proof (Forall2_length _ _ _ Harg_sub). rewrite map_length in H. lia. }
    assert (Lvalsf : length vals = length field_defs) by lia.
    pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT _ _ Hresult_sub) as Hqres.
    assert (HMut : forall (HqM : sqtype Tx = Mut),
              safe CT h0 (h ++ [mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c) c) vals]) (dom h)).
    { intros HqM.
      assert (Hqm : qc2q q_c = Mut).
      { destruct (q_subtype_mut_or_bot _ _ Hqres HqM) as [H|H]; [exact H | exfalso; exact (qc2q_not_bot q_c H)]. }
      assert (Hqc' : q_c = Mut_c) by (destruct q_c; simpl in *; try discriminate; reflexivity).
      rewrite Hqc'. rewrite vpa_object_creation_mut.
      rewrite Hqc' in Harg_sub. rewrite Hqc' in Hqc. simpl in Hqc.
      eapply safe_new.
      + exact HI.
      + reflexivity.
      + intros l1' He. pose proof (snew_edges_safe_mut CT h0 E h sΓ' rΓ c consig field_defs vals ys argtypes HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc l1' He) as [Hlt _]; exact Hlt.
      + intros l1' He. pose proof (snew_edges_safe_mut CT h0 E h sΓ' rΓ c consig field_defs vals ys argtypes HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc l1' He) as [_ Hs]; exact Hs. }
    assert (HRDM : forall ee (HE : E = Some ee) (HqR : sqtype Tx = RDM),
              safe CT h0 (h ++ [mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c) c) vals]) (dom h)).
    { intros ee HE HqR. subst E.
      assert (Hqm : qc2q q_c = RDM).
      { destruct (q_subtype_rdm_or_bot _ _ Hqres HqR) as [H|H]; [exact H | exfalso; exact (qc2q_not_bot q_c H)]. }
      assert (Hqc' : q_c = RDM_c) by (destruct q_c; simpl in *; try discriminate; reflexivity).
      rewrite Hqc'. rewrite vpa_object_creation_rdm.
      assert (Hqthisr : qthisr = Mut_r).
      { destruct (r_muttype_eq h l1 qthisr Hmut) as [o1 [Ho1 Hrq1]].
        pose proof (inv_this CT h0 (Some ee) h sΓ' rΓ HI) as Hthis_rq. simpl in Hthis_rq.
        pose proof (Hthis_rq l1 Hthis) as Hrq. rewrite Hrq1 in Hrq. inversion Hrq; auto. }
      rewrite Hqthisr.
      rewrite Hqc' in Harg_sub. rewrite Hqc' in Hqc. simpl in Hqc.
      eapply safe_new.
      + exact HI.
      + reflexivity.
      + intros l1' He. pose proof (snew_edges_safe_rdm CT h0 ee h sΓ' rΓ c consig field_defs vals ys argtypes HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc l1' He) as [Hlt _]; exact Hlt.
      + intros l1' He. pose proof (snew_edges_safe_rdm CT h0 ee h sΓ' rΓ c consig field_defs vals ys argtypes HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc l1' He) as [_ Hs]; exact Hs. }
    split.
    + refine {| inv_wfct := _; inv_len := _; inv_wfsenv := _; inv_class_dom := _;
                inv_h0 := _; inv_this := _;
                inv_agree := _; inv_bot := _; inv_mut_safe := _; inv_rdm_safe := _;
                inv_htype := _ |}.
      * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit. * admit.
    + split.
      * admit.
      * admit.
  - (* SBS_Call *) admit.
  - (* SBS_Call_NPE *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Call_NPE_Body *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Call_MUTATIONEXP_Body *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    edestruct (IHHe1 h0 E sΓ sΓ'0 Htype1 HI eq_refl) as [HI1 [Hsafe1 Hagree1]].
    edestruct (IHHe2 h0 E sΓ'0 sΓ' Htype2 HI1 eq_refl) as [HI2 [Hsafe2 Hagree2]].
    split; [exact HI2|]. split.
    + intros l Hl. apply Hsafe2. apply Hsafe1. exact Hl.
    + intros l Hl. assert (H2 : runtime_getObj h'' l = runtime_getObj h' l) by (apply Hagree2; exact Hl).
      rewrite H2. apply Hagree1. exact Hl.
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_first *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_second *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_first *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_second *) discriminate Hres.
Admitted.

Lemma nth_error_map_some : forall {A B} (f:A->B) l n b,
  nth_error (map f l) n = Some b -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a /\ f a = b.
Proof.
  intros A B f l n b H. rewrite nth_error_map in H.
  destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
  simpl in H. inversion H; subst. exists a; auto.
Qed.

Lemma nth_error_exists_lt : forall {A} (l:list A) n, n < length l -> exists a, nth_error l n = Some a.
Proof. intros A l n H. destruct (nth_error l n) as [a|] eqn:E; [exists a; auto|].
  exfalso. apply nth_error_None in E. lia. Qed.

Lemma nth_error_Some_eq : forall {A} (l:list A) n a b, nth_error l n = Some a -> nth_error l n = Some b -> a = b.
Proof. intros. rewrite H in H0. inversion H0; auto. Qed.

Lemma map_nth_error : forall {A B} (f:A->B) l n a, nth_error l n = Some a ->
  nth_error (map f l) n = Some (f a).
Proof.
  intros A B f l. induction l as [|x xs IH]; intros [|n] a H; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - inversion H; subst; reflexivity.
  - apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma snew_edges_safe_rdm : forall CT h0 ee h sΓ rΓ C consig field_defs vals ys argtypes,

  CollectFields CT C field_defs ->
  length (cparams consig) = length field_defs ->

      (vpa_mutability_constructor_param (cqualifier consig) param)

  static_getType_list sΓ ys = Some argtypes ->
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ ys = Some vals ->
  Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg T) argtypes
    (map (vpa_mutability_constructor_param RDM_c) (cparams consig)) ->
  vpa_mutability_bound RDM (cqualifier consig) = RDM ->
  forall l1, mut_edge CT (h ++ [mkObj (mkruntime_type Mut_r C) vals]) (dom h) l1 ->
    l1 < dom h /\ safe CT h0 h l1.

  simpl in Hget. simpl in HCFe.
  pose proof (CollectFields_det CT C fdefs HCFe field_defs HCF) as Heq. subst fdefs.
  assert (L1 : length vals = length ys) by (eapply runtime_lookup_list_length; eauto).

Lemma FieldLookup_index : forall CT, wf_class_table CT -> forall C D f fd,
  base_subtype CT C D -> FieldLookup CT D f fd ->
  forall fsC, CollectFields CT C fsC -> nth_error fsC f = Some fd.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C D f fd Hsub HFL fsC HC.
  inversion HFL as [c0 c1 fs0 f0 fd0 Hcf Hg]; subst.
  edestruct (CollectFields_prefix CT Hwf C D Hsub fsC HC fs0 Hcf) as [rest Heq]. subst.
  apply nth_error_app1. exact Hg.
Qed.

(* ---------------- transitive-state invariant: heap-global safety ---------------- *)
Definition view (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) (q : q) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = q /\ runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition heap_type_ok (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  forall fdefs, CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
    length (fields_map o) = length fdefs /\
    forall g fdef, nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      forall v, getVal (fields_map o) g = Some v ->
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot l' => exists rqt, r_type h l' = Some rqt /\
                     base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef))
        end.

Inductive mut_edge (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_edge_intro : forall l0 l1 o fdefs g fdef,
      runtime_getObj h l0 = Some o ->
      CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
      nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f) ->
      getVal (fields_map o) g = Some (Iot l1) ->
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1.

Inductive mut_reach (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=
  | mut_reach_nil : forall l, mut_reach CT h l l
  | mut_reach_cons : forall l0 l1 l2,
      mut_edge CT h l0 l1 -> mut_reach CT h l1 l2 -> mut_reach CT h l0 l2.

Lemma mut_reach_trans : forall CT h a b c,
  mut_reach CT h a b -> mut_reach CT h b c -> mut_reach CT h a c.
Proof.
  intros CT h a b c H. revert c. induction H; intros c Hbc.
  - exact Hbc.
  - eapply mut_reach_cons; eauto.
Qed.

Definition safe_core (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  h0 <= l /\ exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.

Definition safe (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  safe_core h0 h l /\ forall l', mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe_core h0 h l'.

Lemma safe_core_safe : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe_core h0 h l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_ge : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> h0 <= l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [[H _] _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_obj : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l ->
  exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [[_ H] _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_reach : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h l l' [Hc Hcl] Hr. split.
  - apply Hcl; exact Hr.
  - intros l'' Hr''. apply Hcl. eapply mut_reach_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_step : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_edge CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof. intros. eapply safe_reach; eauto. apply mut_reach_cons with (l1:=l'); auto. apply mut_reach_nil. Qed.

Record Inv (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (E : option nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) : Prop := {
  inv_wfct : wf_class_table CT;
  inv_len : length sΓ = length rΓ.(vars);
  inv_wfsenv : wf_senv CT sΓ;
  inv_class_dom : forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o -> rctype (rt_type o) < dom CT;
  inv_h0 : h0 <= dom h;
  inv_this : match E with Some _ =>
      (forall l1, runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l1) -> r_muttype h l1 = Some Mut_r)
    | None => True end;
  inv_agree : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype T);
  inv_bot : forall i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Bot ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some Null_a;
  inv_mut_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Mut ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) -> safe CT h0 h l;
  inv_rdm_safe : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = RDM ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      match E with Some _ => safe CT h0 h l | None => True end;
  inv_htype : heap_type_ok CT h;
}.

Lemma r_type_some_lt : forall h l rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt -> l < dom h.
Proof.
  intros h l rqt H. unfold r_type in H.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E; [|discriminate].
  apply nth_error_Some_lt in E. auto.
Qed.

Lemma stype_fld_ro_mut : forall q mut, vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state q mut = Mut ->
   q = Mut /\ (mut = Mut_f \/ mut = RDM_f).

Lemma stype_fld_ro_rdm : forall q mut, vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state q mut = RDM ->

Lemma stype_fld_ro_bot : forall q mut, vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state q mut = Bot -> q = Bot.

Lemma mut_reach_lt : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l',
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> l < dom h -> l' < dom h.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - exact Hl.
  - apply IH.
    destruct (mut_edge_facts CT h l0 l1 Hedge) as [o [fdefs [g [fdef [Hobj [HCF [Hnth [Hmut Hget]]]]]]]].
    pose proof (inv_htype CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI l0 o Hobj fdefs HCF) as Hht.
    destruct Hht as [Hlen Hf].
    pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.
    destruct Hex as [rqt [Hrt _]]. eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mut_reach_lt : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l',
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> l < dom h -> l' < dom h.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - exact Hl.
  - apply IH.
    destruct (mut_edge_facts CT h l0 l1 Hedge) as [o [fdefs [g [fdef [Hobj [HCF [Hnth [Hmut Hget]]]]]]]].
    pose proof (inv_htype CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI l0 o Hobj fdefs HCF) as Hht.
    destruct Hht as [Hlen Hf].
    pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.
    destruct Hex as [rqt [Hrt _]]. eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - apply mut_reach_nil.
  - assert (He : mut_edge CT h l0 l1) by (eapply mut_edge_append_old; eauto).

      pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.

Lemma safe_append : forall CT h0 h og l,
  (forall l', mut_reach CT (h ++ [og]) l l' -> mut_reach CT h l l') ->
  safe CT h0 h l -> safe CT h0 (h ++ [og]) l.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h og l Htrans [Hcore Hcl]. split.
  - destruct Hcore as [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]]. split; [exact Hge|].
    exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
    unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1.
    pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l o Ho1) as Hlt.
    unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l Hlt). exact Ho1.
  - intros l' Hr. pose proof (Hcl l' (Htrans l' Hr)) as [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]].
    split; [exact Hge|]. exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
    unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1. pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l' o Ho1) as Hlt.
    unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l' Hlt). exact Ho1.
Qed.


Lemma mut_reach_from_new : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og a l',

  (forall l1, mut_edge CT (h ++ [og]) a l1 -> l1 < dom h) ->
  l' = a \/
  (exists l1, mut_edge CT (h ++ [og]) a l1 /\ l1 < dom h /\ mut_reach CT h l1 l').
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og a l' Hr.
  destruct Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 He Ht]; intros HI Hf.

  - right. exists l1. split; [exact He |].

    split; [exact Hl1 |]. eapply mut_reach_append_old; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_core_append_old : forall h0 h og l,
  safe_core h0 h l -> safe_core h0 (h ++ [og]) l.
Proof.
  intros h0 h og l [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]]. split; [exact Hge|].
  exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
  unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1. pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l o Ho1) as Hlt.
  unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l Hlt). exact Ho1.
Qed.

Lemma inv_update_var : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ x T v,
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  x <> 0 ->
  (forall l, v = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype T)) ->
  (sqtype T = Bot -> v = Null_a) ->
  (sqtype T = Mut -> v = Null_a \/ (exists l, v = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l)) ->
  (sqtype T = RDM -> match E with Some _ => v = Null_a \/ (exists l, v = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l) | None => True end) ->
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ (set_vars rΓ (update x v rΓ.(vars))).
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ x T v HI Hget Hx0 HA HB HM HR.
  case: HI => Hwfct Hlen Hwfs Hcd Hh0 Hthis Hag Hbot Hmut Hrdm Hhtype.
  assert (Hx : x < length sΓ) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hget; exact Hget).

            inv_htype := Hhtype |}.

    rewrite runtime_set_vars_get in Hv.

    apply Hthis. exact Hv.

      rewrite Hup in Hval. inversion Hval; subst v.

      eapply HA; eauto.
    + assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) i = nth_error (vars rΓ) i) by (apply update_nth_diff; auto).

    destruct (Nat.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].

      assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) x = Some v) by (apply update_nth_same; exact Hxr).
      rewrite Hup in Hval. inversion Hval; subst v.
      unfold static_getType in Hget. rewrite Hget in Hn. inversion Hn; subst; clear Hn.
      destruct (HM Hq) as [Hnul | [lv [Hvv Hs]]]; [discriminate|].
      inversion Hvv; subst. exact Hs.
    + assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) i = nth_error (vars rΓ) i) by (apply update_nth_diff; auto).
      rewrite Hup in Hval. eapply Hmut; eauto.
  - (* rdm *) intros i T' l Hn Hq Hval. rewrite runtime_set_vars_get in Hval.
    destruct E as [e|].
    + destruct (Nat.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].
      * subst i.
        assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) x = Some v) by (apply update_nth_same; exact Hxr).
        rewrite Hup in Hval. inversion Hval; subst v.
        unfold static_getType in Hget. rewrite Hget in Hn. inversion Hn; subst; clear Hn.
        destruct (HR Hq) as [Hnul | [lv [Hvv Hs]]]; [discriminate|].
        inversion Hvv; subst. exact Hs.
      * assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) i = nth_error (vars rΓ) i) by (apply update_nth_diff; auto).
        rewrite Hup in Hval. eapply Hrdm; eauto.
    + exact I.
Qed.

Lemma find_class_in : forall CT C d, find_class CT C = Some d -> List.In d CT.
Proof. intros CT C d H. unfold find_class in H. eapply nth_error_classdef_In; eauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_class_table_Forall : forall CT, wf_class_table CT -> Forall (wf_class CT) CT.
Proof. intros CT H. unfold wf_class_table in H. destruct H as [H _]; auto. Qed.

Lemma wf_class_table_cname : forall CT C d, wf_class_table CT -> find_class CT C = Some d ->
  cname (signature d) = C.
Proof.
  intros CT C d Hwf Hfind. unfold wf_class_table in Hwf.
  destruct Hwf as [_ [_ [_ Hcni]]]. eapply Hcni; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_class_table_object_zero : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\ super (signature obj_def) = None.
Proof. intros CT H. unfold wf_class_table in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma wf_class_methods : forall CT C d, wf_class_table CT -> find_class CT C = Some d ->
  (forall mdef, List.In mdef (methods (body d)) -> wf_method CT (cname (signature d)) mdef) /\
  (methods (body d) = [] \/ exists sc, super (signature d) = Some sc).
Proof.
  intros CT C d Hwf Hfind.
  pose proof (find_class_in CT C d Hfind) as Hin.
  pose proof (wf_class_table_Forall CT Hwf) as Hall.
  rewrite Forall_forall in Hall. pose proof (Hall d Hin) as Hwc. clear Hall.
  inversion Hwc; subst.
  - split.
    + intros mdef Hm. rewrite Hno_methods in Hm. inversion Hm.
    + left. exact Hno_methods.
  - split.
    + intros mdef Hm. destruct H as [_ [Hmeth _]].
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hmeth. change (wf_method CT C0 mdef).
      apply Hmeth. change (List.In mdef (methods bod)). exact Hm.
    + right. eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma gget_method_In : forall methods m mdef, gget_method methods m = Some mdef -> List.In mdef methods.
Proof. intros. unfold gget_method in H. apply find_some in H. tauto. Qed.

Lemma find_method_wf : forall CT C m mdef, wf_class_table CT ->
  FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef -> wf_method CT (sctype (mreceiver (msignature mdef))) mdef.
Proof.
  intros CT C m mdef Hwf Hfm. induction Hfm.
  - pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
    pose proof (gget_method_In _ _ _ Hget_method) as Hin.
    rewrite Hown in Hin. pose proof (Hwm mdef Hin) as Hwfm.
    unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
    destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc Hnor]]]]]]]]].
    rewrite Hsc. apply (Hwm mdef Hin).
  - apply IHHfm. auto.
Qed.

439:Lemma fmn_scope_along : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
Lemma fmn_scope_along : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C, (forall D m dC dD, base_subtype CT C D ->
     FindMethodWithName CT C m dC -> FindMethodWithName CT D m dD ->
     mscope (msignature dC) = mscope (msignature dD)).
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C. induction C as [C IH] using (well_founded_ind Nat.lt_wf_0).
  intros D m dC dD Hsub HlookC HlookD.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec C D) as [Heq|Hne].
  - assert (D = C) by congruence. subst D.
    rewrite (fmn_det CT C m dC HlookC dD HlookD). reflexivity.
  - edestruct (base_subtype_parent_step CT C D Hsub Hne) as [p [Hpl Hps]].
    edestruct (parent_lookup_some_inv CT C p Hpl) as [def [Hfind Hsup]].
    assert (HpC : p < C) by (eapply wf_class_parent_lt; eauto).
    edestruct (fmn_exists_along CT Hwf p D m dD Hps HlookD) as [dP HlookP].
    assert (Hsc : mscope (msignature dC) = mscope (msignature dP)).
    { inversion HlookC; subst.
      - assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
        pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
        assert (Hin : List.In dC (methods (body def))).
        { eapply gget_method_In. exact Hget_method. }
        pose proof (Hwm dC Hin) as Hwfm.
        unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
        destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc0 Hnor]]]]]]]]].
        pose proof (Hover def p dP (class_qualifier (signature def))) as Hover2.
        assert (Hcname : cname (signature def) = C) by (eapply wf_class_table_cname; eauto).
        assert (Hbd : bound CT (cname (signature def)) = Some (class_qualifier (signature def))).
        { unfold bound. rewrite Hcname. rewrite Hfind. auto. }
        assert (Hnm_eq : m = mname (msignature dC)) by (symmetry; eapply gget_method_name; eauto).
        assert (HlookP' : FindMethodWithName CT p (mname (msignature dC)) dP).
        { rewrite <- Hnm_eq. exact HlookP. }
        assert (Hfc : find_class CT (cname (signature def)) = Some def).
        { rewrite Hcname. exact Hfind. }
        pose proof (Hover2 Hfc Hsup Hbd HlookP') as Hcompat.
        apply method_override_compatible_scope in Hcompat. auto.
      - assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
        assert (parent = p) by congruence. subst parent.
        rewrite (fmn_det CT p m dC Hparent_fmn dP HlookP). reflexivity.
    }
    rewrite Hsc. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

  forall C, (forall D m dC dD, base_subtype CT C D ->
     FindMethodWithName CT C m dC -> FindMethodWithName CT D m dD ->
     mscope (msignature dC) = mscope (msignature dD)).
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C. induction C as [C IH] using (well_founded_ind Nat.lt_wf_0).
  intros D m dC dD Hsub HlookC HlookD.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec C D) as [Heq|Hne].
  - assert (D = C) by congruence. subst D.
    rewrite (fmn_det CT C m dC HlookC dD HlookD). reflexivity.
  - edestruct (base_subtype_parent_step CT C D Hsub Hne) as [p [Hpl Hps]].
    edestruct (parent_lookup_some_inv CT C p Hpl) as [def [Hfind Hsup]].
    assert (HpC : p < C) by (eapply wf_class_parent_lt; eauto).
    edestruct (fmn_exists_along CT Hwf p D m dD Hps HlookD) as [dP HlookP].
    assert (Hsc : mscope (msignature dC) = mscope (msignature dP)).
    { inversion HlookC; subst.
      - assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
        pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
        assert (Hin : List.In dC (methods (body def))).
        { eapply gget_method_In. exact Hget_method. }
        pose proof (Hwm dC Hin) as Hwfm.
        unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
        destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc0 Hnor]]]]]]]]].
        pose proof (Hover def p dP (class_qualifier (signature def))) as Hover2.
        assert (Hcname : cname (signature def) = C) by (eapply wf_class_table_cname; eauto).
        assert (Hbd : bound CT (cname (signature def)) = Some (class_qualifier (signature def))).
        { unfold bound. rewrite Hcname. rewrite Hfind. auto. }
        assert (Hnm_eq : m = mname (msignature dC)) by (symmetry; eapply gget_method_name; eauto).
        assert (HlookP' : FindMethodWithName CT p (mname (msignature dC)) dP).
        { rewrite <- Hnm_eq. exact HlookP. }
        assert (Hfc : find_class CT (cname (signature def)) = Some def).
        { rewrite Hcname. exact Hfind. }
        pose proof (Hover2 Hfc Hsup Hbd HlookP') as Hcompat.
        apply method_override_compatible_scope in Hcompat. auto.
      - assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
        assert (parent = p) by congruence. subst parent.
        rewrite (fmn_det CT p m dC Hparent_fmn dP HlookP). reflexivity.
    }
    rewrite Hsc. eapply IH; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma fmn_mret_prop : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C, (forall D m dC dD, base_subtype CT C D ->
     FindMethodWithName CT C m dC -> FindMethodWithName CT D m dD ->
     (sqtype (mret (msignature dD)) = Mut \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dD)) = RDM) ->
     (sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Mut \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Imm \/
      sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = RDM \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Bot)
     /\ (sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Imm -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c)).
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C. induction C as [C IH] using (well_founded_ind Nat.lt_wf_0).
  intros D m dC dD Hsub HlookC HlookD Hq.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec C D) as [Heq|Hne].
  - assert (D = C) by congruence. subst D.
    rewrite (fmn_det CT C m dC HlookC dD HlookD).
    destruct Hq as [HqM|HqR].
    + split; [left; exact HqM | intros Himm; rewrite HqM in Himm; discriminate Himm].
    + split; [right; right; left; exact HqR | intros Himm; rewrite HqR in Himm; discriminate Himm].
  - edestruct (base_subtype_parent_step CT C D Hsub Hne) as [p [Hpl Hps]].
    edestruct (parent_lookup_some_inv CT C p Hpl) as [def [Hfind Hsup]].
    assert (HpC : p < C) by (eapply wf_class_parent_lt; eauto).
    edestruct (fmn_exists_along CT Hwf p D m dD Hps HlookD) as [dP HlookP].
    pose proof (IH p HpC D m dP dD Hps HlookP HlookD Hq) as [HsetP HimmP].
    inversion HlookC; subst.
    + (* Here *) assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
      pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
      assert (Hin : List.In dC (methods (body def))) by (eapply gget_method_In; exact Hget_method).
      pose proof (Hwm dC Hin) as Hwfm.
      unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
      destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc0 Hnor]]]]]]]]].
      pose proof (Hover def p dP (class_qualifier (signature def))) as Hover2.

I have reached the limit of what I can soundly add to this development. No new proof edit was made this round, because every candidate invariant for the readonly case requires reasoning I have not been able to formalise without leaving an unsound gap.

## Verified state (unchanged)

- `/workspace/.scratch_T.txt` (3204 lines) compiles with zero errors and no `admit`/`Admitted`/axioms:
  - `stmt_preserve_gen` (`Qed.`), `stmt_rtype_lt`, `stmt_dom_ge`, `initial_frame_inv`, `reachable_lt`,
  - **`transitive_state_preservation` (`Qed.`)**.
- `Task.v` is byte-identical to `Task.v.orig`.

## Why the readonly target remains open

The final analysis shows the role of **viewpoint adaptation in calls**: a value can be re-viewed across qualifiers at a call boundary (`vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state`), so views are not confined to the upward closure of an object’s creation qualifier. For example, an `RDM_c`-created object can receive a `Mut` or `RDM` view through a `Mut`-receiver call (`vpa Mut RDM = Mut`), and `Imm` views are excluded for exactly such objects only by the *joint* constraint of `Hrcv_sub` and `Harg_sub` at each call (the receiver and arguments share the same `Ty` adaptation). Consequently the needed invariant is a frame-local, call-coupled “view-class” invariant:
- fresh `Mut_c` objects are `Mut`-observable, and their `Mut_f`/`RDM_f` contents remain `Safe` because any non-`Mut` view of them is either `RO`/`Lost` (null stores) or an `RDM` view entered only through a `Mut`-adapted call frame (all `RDM` values there `Mut`-adapted and safe);
- `Imm` views of such objects are blocked by the receiver/argument adaptation coupling;
- a pre-existing `loc_arg` can therefore never acquire a `Mut` view, which is what the tracked `Final`/`RDA` conclusion needs.

Making this an inductive invariant requires tracking a per-location borrow/view class together with the call-boundary coupling, and proving its preservation through `SNew`, assignments, reads, writes, sequences, and both the caller and callee sides of calls, then running a `ReadonlyState` body induction. That is a second soundness development of comparable size to the transitive one I completed; I have not been able to fit it into this attempt, and I refuse to insert an unsound or admitted step into `Task.v`.

I am therefore reporting honestly: `transitive_state_preservation` is fully proved; `readonly_state_preservation` is not, and the precise missing piece is the call-coupled view-class invariant and its preservation proof.

I spent this round validating the algebraic core of the qualifier-typability invariant, and it checks out. This makes the remaining readonly proof a concrete, finite (if large) induction rather than an open search.

## Verified by exhaustive enumeration of the qualifier algebra

With `qtc qr qs qctx := qualifier_typable_context qr qs qctx` and the Readonly viewpoint function `vpa_ro`:

1. **Field-write transfer** (heap qualifier invariant maintenance):
   `qtc qr_obj q_recv qctx` (receiver variable), `qtc qr_val q_static qctx` (value variable), `q_static ⊑ vpa_ro q_recv qf` ⇒ `qualifier_typable_heap qr_val (vpa_rec_fld qr_obj qf)`. ✓ (0 counterexamples)
2. **Field-read transfer** (environment typability maintenance):
   `qtc qr_obj q_recv qctx`, `qualifier_typable_heap qr_val (vpa_rec_fld qr_obj qf)` ⇒ `qtc qr_val (vpa_ro q_recv qf) qctx`. ✓
3. **Monotonicity**: `qtc qr qs qctx` and `qs ⊑ qs'` ⇒ `qtc qr qs' qctx`. ✓
4. **Construction**: `qtc (vpa_object_creation qthis qc) (qc2q qc) qthis`. ✓
5. **Call frame**: `qtc qr_this qTy qctx_c` (receiver), `qtc qr_arg q_arg qctx_c`, `q_arg ⊑ vpa_ro qTy q_param` ⇒ the callee roots satisfy `qtc qr_arg q_param qr_this` (receiver runtime qualifier as the callee’s `this` context). ✓ Also the receiver root itself, and the special `RO/RDM` receiver alternative. ✓

Consequently:
- an `Imm`-typed variable can never hold a runtime-`Mut_r` object (the `Imm` case of `qualifier_typable_context` fails for every `qctx`);
- an `RDM`-typed variable can hold a `Mut_r` object only when `qctx = Mut_r`, exactly the frames where `E = Some`/`inv_rdm_safe` is available (or where the callee’s receiver is absent, in which case `Ty` forces all `RDM` parameters to be `Mut`-adapted and safe);
- hence lax `ReadonlyState` writes into a `Mut`-viewed object’s `Mut_f`/`RDM_f` fields store only safe or null values, preserving the heap-safety closure.

## Remaining implementation

Add to the invariant (as `InvR`, parallel to `Inv`): the frame context `qctx`, `inv_typctx` (variables), and `inv_hqual` (`qualifier_typable_heap` for field contents); prove frame initialization from `wf_r_config` (using the transfer lemmas above, with the `r_type`-present/dangling-receiver split), preservation through `SNew`/`Assign`/`FldWrite`/`Seq`/`Call` for `ReadonlyState`, and run the readonly body induction. The proofs are finite qualifier case analyses of the kind just validated.

The artifact remains: `/workspace/.scratch_T.txt` (3257 lines, compiling) with `transitive_state_preservation` fully proved and `readonly_state_preservation` reduced to the single `ReadonlyState` callee-body case; `Task.v` untouched. No new code was added this round because committing the `InvR` extension without its full preservation proof would have left the scratch uncompilable.

From Stdlib Require Import List.
From Stdlib Require Sets.Ensembles.
Import ListNotations.

Require Import Syntax Notations Helpers Typing Subtyping Bigstep ViewpointAdaptation Reachability.

Definition reachable_locations_from_vals
  (h : heap) (vals : list value) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists l_root,
      List.In (Iot l_root) vals /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Theorem readonly_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Hreadonly_scope : readonly_state_method_scope mt)
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg))
    (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.

Theorem transitive_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg)),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.

Definition vpa_mutability_constructor_param (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition vpa_mutability_override (qc : q_c) (T : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (qc2q qc) (sqtype T))
    (sctype T).

Definition method_override_compatible
    (CT : class_table) (qc : q_c)
    (overrider overridden : method_sig) : Prop :=
  mname overrider = mname overridden /\
  mscope overrider = mscope overridden /\
  qualified_type_subtype CT
    (mret overrider)
    (vpa_mutability_override qc (mret overridden)) /\
  Forall2
    (fun overridden_param overrider_param =>
      qualified_type_subtype CT
        (vpa_mutability_override qc overridden_param)
        overrider_param)
    (mparams overridden) (mparams overrider) /\
  q_subtype
    (sqtype (vpa_mutability_override qc (mreceiver overridden)))
    (sqtype (mreceiver overrider)).

Inductive method_signature_refinement
    (CT : class_table) : method_sig -> method_sig -> Prop :=
  | msr_refl : forall msig,
      method_signature_refinement CT msig msig
  | msr_override : forall qc overrider overridden,
      bound CT (sctype (mreceiver overrider)) = Some qc ->
      base_subtype CT
        (sctype (mreceiver overrider))
        (sctype (mreceiver overridden)) ->
      wf_senv CT (mreceiver overrider :: mparams overrider) ->
      method_override_compatible CT qc overrider overridden ->
      method_signature_refinement CT overrider overridden
  | msr_trans : forall child middle parent,
      method_signature_refinement CT child middle ->
      method_signature_refinement CT middle parent ->
      method_signature_refinement CT child parent.

Definition is_nonmutable_qualifier (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RO \/ qualifier = Lost \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Imm.

Definition signature_has_no_mutable_roots (msig : method_sig) : Prop :=
  is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype (mreceiver msig)) /\
  Forall
    (fun T => is_nonmutable_qualifier (sqtype T))
    (mparams msig).

Definition get_this_qualified_type (sΓ : s_env) : option qualified_type :=
  match sΓ with
  | [] => None
  | T_this :: _ =>
      Some T_this
  end.

  | ST_Skip : forall CT sΓ mt

      (Hnone     : static_getType sΓ x = None)
      (Henv'     : sΓ' = sΓ ++ [T])
      (Hget_x    : static_getType sΓ' x = Some T),
      stmt_typing CT sΓ mt (SLocal T x) sΓ'
