      (Hget_y      : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
      (Hthis       : get_this_qualified_type sΓ = Some Tthis)
      (Hfld_def    : sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fieldT)
      (Hassign_rel : sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a)
      (Hsub        : qualified_type_subtype CT Ty

                         (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fieldT)))
                         (f_base_type (ftype fieldT))))

Theorem transitive_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f

    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg)),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.

         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
         Hstmt Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj.
  subst stmt.
  inversion Heval; subst; clear Heval.
  assert (Ely0 : ly0 = ly) by congruence. subst ly0.
  assert (Evals0 : vals0 = vals) by congruence. subst vals0.
  match goal with H : eval_stmt CT _ h _ OK _ h' |- _ => rename H into Hebody end.
  rename mdef0 into mdef_run.
  destruct Hfind as [Hfmn_run Hmb]. subst mbody.
  inversion Htyping; subst; clear Htyping.
  - (* ST_Call *) destruct Hscope as [Habs|[Hcs _]]; [discriminate Habs|discriminate Hcs].
  - (* ST_Call_readonly_state *)
    rename mdef0 into mdef_sta.
    rename Hfind_m into Hfmn_static.
    rename Harg_sub into Hargsub.
    rename Hmt_sub into Hmtsub.
    assert (ETy : Ty0 = Ty) by congruence. subst Ty0.
    assert (Hwfct := proj1 Hwf).
    assert (Hheap := proj1 (proj2 Hwf)).
    assert (Hrenv := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))).
    assert (Hwfsenv := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf)))).
    assert (Hlen := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))))).
    assert (Hclause := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))))).
    unfold wf_renv in Hrenv.
    destruct Hrenv as [_ [Hthis0 _]].
    destruct Hthis0 as [iot [Hiot Hiotlt]].
    destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h iot Hiotlt) as [oth Hoth].
    assert (Hctx : r_muttype h iot = Some (rqtype (rt_type oth))).
    { unfold r_muttype. unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite Hoth. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hys : y < length sΓ') by (eapply nth_error_Some_lt; exact Hstatic_type).
    assert (Hbsy : base_subtype CT cy (sctype Ty)).
    { unfold r_basetype in Hbase.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h ly) as [o|] eqn:Eo; [simpl in Hbase; inversion Hbase; subst cy | discriminate Hbase].
      pose proof (Hclause iot (rqtype (rt_type oth)) Hiot Hctx y Hys Ty Hstatic_type) as Hcl.
      rewrite Hget_y in Hcl. unfold wf_r_typable in Hcl.
      destruct (r_type h ly) as [rqt|] eqn:Er; [|contradiction].
      destruct Hcl as [Hbs _]. unfold r_type in Er. rewrite Eo in Er. simpl in Er. inversion Er; subst rqt.
      exact Hbs. }
    pose proof (mss_trans _ Hmtsub) as Hmsc0.
    pose proof (fmn_scope_along CT Hwfct cy (sctype Ty) mindex mdef_run mdef_sta Hbsy Hfmn_run Hfmn_static) as Hsc.
    rewrite Hmsc0 in Hsc.
    pose proof (fmn_sig_refine CT Hwfct cy (sctype Ty) mindex mdef_run mdef_sta Hbsy Hfmn_run Hfmn_static) as Hsig.
    pose proof (fmn_receiver_le CT Hwfct cy mindex mdef_run Hfmn_run) as Hrecv_le.
    pose proof (find_method_wf CT cy mindex mdef_run Hwfct Hfmn_run) as Hwfm.
    unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
    destruct Hwfm as [Hret_wf [sGr [retTr [Hbody [Hlt_r [Hnth_r [Hret_sub_r [Hover [Hsc_cl Hnor]]]]]]]]].
    rewrite Hsc in Hbody.
    rewrite Hsc in Hnor.
    pose proof (Hnor (or_intror eq_refl)) as HnoMut.
    pose proof (stmt_typing_wf_senv CT _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfs_body.
    assert (Hrecv_base : forall o, runtime_getObj h ly = Some o ->
        base_subtype CT (rctype (rt_type o)) (sctype (mreceiver (msignature mdef_run)))).
    { intros o Ho. unfold r_basetype in Hbase.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h ly) as [o'|] eqn:Eo'; [simpl in Hbase; inversion Hbase; subst cy | discriminate Hbase].
      assert (o = o') by congruence. subst o. exact Hrecv_le. }
    assert (HI_frame : Inv CT (dom h) None h (mreceiver (msignature mdef_run) :: mparams (msignature mdef_run)) {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |}).
    { eapply (initial_frame_inv CT sΓ' rΓ h None y zs argtypes Ty ly vals (msignature mdef_sta) (msignature mdef_run)).
      + exact Hwf. + exact Hstatic_type. + exact Hget_args. + exact Hget_y. + exact Hget_zs.
      + exact Hwfs_body. + exact HnoMut. + exact Hsig. + exact Hargsub. + exact Hrecv_base.
      + simpl; exact I. + intros; exact I. }
    pose proof (stmt_preserve_gen CT {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |} h (mbody_stmt (mbody mdef_run)) OK rΓ'' h'
      Hebody (dom h) None (mreceiver (msignature mdef_run) :: mparams (msignature mdef_run)) sGr Hbody HI_frame eq_refl) as Hres.
    destruct Hres as [_ [_ Hbelow]].
    assert (Hlt : loc_arg < dom h).
    { destruct HinP as [l_root [Hin Hreach]]. eapply reachable_lt; exact Hreach. }
    exists vals_arg. split.
    + rewrite (Hbelow loc_arg Hlt). exact Harg_obj.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))

    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Hreadonly_scope : readonly_state_method_scope mt)
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg))
    (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
         Hstmt Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Hreadonly_scope Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj Hassign.
  subst stmt.
  destruct Hreadonly_scope as [Hmt|Hmt]; subst mt.
  - (* mt = ReadonlyState *)
    inversion Htyping; subst; clear Htyping.
    + (* ST_Call *) destruct Hscope as [Habs|[Hcs _]]; [discriminate Habs|discriminate Hcs].
    + (* ST_Call_readonly_state *)
      inversion Hmt_sub; subst.
      * (* callee scope ReadonlyState *) admit.
      * (* callee scope TransitiveState *)
        assert (HtypingT : stmt_typing CT sΓ' TransitiveState (SCall x mindex y zs) sΓ').
        { eapply (ST_Call_readonly_state CT sΓ' TransitiveState x mindex y zs argtypes Tthis Tx Ty0 mdef0).
          - exact Hwf0.
          - exact Hget_x.
          - exact Hget_y0.
          - exact Hget_args.
          - exact Hthis.
          - exact Hfind_m.
          - exact Hnot_rcv.
          - exact Hmt_not_abs.
          - exact Hmt_not_cs.
          - exact Hret_sub.
          - exact Hrcv_sub.
          - exact Harg_sub.
          - discriminate.
          - discriminate.
          - rewrite <- H0. apply method_subtyping_refl. }
        exact (transitive_state_preservation CT sΓ' rΓ h (SCall x mindex y zs) rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f eq_refl Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf HtypingT Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj).
  - (* mt = TransitiveState *)
    exact (transitive_state_preservation CT sΓ rΓ h (SCall x mindex y zs) rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f eq_refl Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj).
Admitted.

Definition wf_obj (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc) : Prop :=
  match runtime_getObj h ι with
  | None => False
  | Some o =>

      wf_rtypeuse CT (rt_type o).(rqtype) (rt_type o).(rctype) /\

      exists field_defs, CollectFields CT (rt_type o).(rctype) field_defs /\
      List.length (fields_map o) = List.length field_defs /\
      Forall2 (fun v fdef =>
        match v with
        | Null_a => True
        | Iot loc =>
          match runtime_getObj h loc with
          | Some _ =>

            exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\
            base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (f_base_type (ftype fdef)) /\
            qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt) (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
          | None => False
          end
        end) (fields_map o) field_defs
  end.

Definition wf_renv (CT: class_table) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  dom rΓ.(vars) > 0 /\
  (exists iot, get_this_var_mapping rΓ.(vars) = Some iot /\ iot < dom h) /\
  Forall (fun value =>
    match value with
    | Null_a => True
    | Iot loc =>
        match runtime_getObj h loc with
        | None => False
        | Some _ => True
        end
    end) rΓ.(vars).

Definition wf_heap (CT: class_table) (h: heap) : Prop :=
    forall (ι : Loc),
    ι < (List.length h) ->
    wf_obj CT h ι.

Definition wf_r_typable (CT: class_table) (h: heap) (ι: Loc)
  (sqt: qualified_type) (qcontext: q_r) : Prop :=
  match r_type h ι with
  | Some rqt =>
      base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt) /\
      qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype sqt) qcontext
  | _ => False
  end.

Definition wf_r_config (CT: class_table) (sΓ: s_env) (rΓ: r_env) (h: heap) : Prop :=

  wf_class_table CT /\

  wf_heap CT h /\

  wf_renv CT rΓ h /\

  wf_senv CT sΓ /\

  List.length sΓ = List.length rΓ.(vars) /\
  forall ι qcontext,
  get_this_var_mapping (vars rΓ) = Some ι ->
  (r_muttype h ι) = Some qcontext ->
  forall i, i < List.length sΓ ->
  forall sqt,

    nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
    match runtime_getVal rΓ i with
    | Some (Iot loc) => wf_r_typable CT h loc sqt qcontext
    | Some Null_a => True
    | None => False
    end.

Inductive eval_result :=
| OK : eval_result
| MUTATIONEXP: eval_result
| NPE : eval_result.

Definition runtime_vpa_assignability (q1: q_r) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | Mut_r, RDA => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

Definition reachable_locations_from_initial_env
  (h : heap) (rΓ : r_env) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target =>
    exists x l_root ,
      runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot l_root) /\
      reachable h l_root l_target.

Inductive eval_expr : class_table -> r_env -> heap -> expr -> value -> eval_result -> r_env -> heap -> Prop :=

  | EBS_Null : forall CT rΓ h,
      eval_expr CT rΓ h ENull Null_a OK rΓ h

(* ---------------- field collection lemmas ---------------- *)
Lemma CollectFields_det : forall CT C fs1, CollectFields CT C fs1 ->
  forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1. induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst; clear H2;
    try reflexivity; try congruence.
  - assert (def = def0) by congruence. subst def0.
    assert (parent = parent0) by congruence. subst parent0.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det : forall CT C f fd1, FieldLookup CT C f fd1 ->
  forall fd2, FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 H1 fd2 H2.
  inversion H1; inversion H2; subst; clear H1; clear H2.
  assert (fields = fields0) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst.
  rewrite Hget in Hget0. inversion Hget0; auto.
Qed.

Lemma find_class_some_eq : forall CT C d1 d2, find_class CT C = Some d1 -> find_class CT C = Some d2 -> d1 = d2.
Proof. intros. rewrite H in H0. inversion H0; auto. Qed.

Lemma parent_lookup_find : forall CT C d, find_class CT C = Some d ->
  parent_lookup CT C = super (signature d).
Proof. intros. unfold parent_lookup. rewrite H. auto. Qed.

Lemma base_subtype_dom_l : forall CT C D, base_subtype CT C D -> C < dom CT.
Proof. intros CT C D H. induction H; auto. Qed.

Lemma CollectFields_prefix : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C D, base_subtype CT C D ->
  forall fsC, CollectFields CT C fsC -> forall fsD, CollectFields CT D fsD ->
  exists rest, fsC = fsD ++ rest.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C D Hsub. induction Hsub; intros fsC HC fsD HD.
  - exists []. rewrite (CollectFields_det CT C fsC HC fsD HD). rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity.
  - destruct (find_class_of_lt CT D (base_subtype_dom_l CT D E Hsub2)) as [dD HfindD].
    destruct (CollectFields_exists CT D dD Hwf HfindD) as [fsD' HD'].
    edestruct IHHsub1 as [r1 Hr1]; eauto.
    edestruct IHHsub2 as [r2 Hr2]; eauto.
    exists (r2 ++ r1). rewrite Hr1. rewrite Hr2. symmetry; apply app_assoc.
  - inversion HC; subst; clear HC.
    + unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hnone in Hparent. discriminate.
    + unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hfind in Hparent.
      simpl in Hparent. rewrite Hsuper in Hparent. discriminate.
    + unfold parent_lookup in Hparent. rewrite Hfind in Hparent.
      simpl in Hparent. rewrite Hsuper in Hparent. inversion Hparent; subst.
      assert (Hpeq : parent_fields = fsD) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst parent_fields.
      exists (fields (body def)). reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C D f fd Hsub HFL fsC HC.
  inversion HFL as [c0 c1 fs0 f0 fd0 Hcf Hg]; subst.
  edestruct (CollectFields_prefix CT Hwf C D Hsub fsC HC fs0 Hcf) as [rest Heq]. subst.
  apply nth_error_app1. exact Hg.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

From Stdlib Require Import List.

From Stdlib Require String.

Require Import Stdlib.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Stdlib.Classes.RelationClasses.

Import ListNotations.

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k
      (Hdom        : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj        : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals))
      (Hfield      : nth_error vals k = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hmut_abs    : sf_mutability_rel CT C k RDM_f \/ sf_mutability_rel CT C k Imm_f)
      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target => reachable_abs CT h l_root l_target.

Inductive reachable (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | rch_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable h l l

  | rch_step : forall l0 l1 obj f
      (Hdom    : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj    : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj)
      (Hfield  : getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1)),
      reachable h l0 l1

  | rch_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable h l1 l2),
      reachable h l0 l2.

Definition heap_edge (h : heap) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists obj f,
    runtime_getObj h l0 = Some obj /\
    getVal obj.(fields_map) f = Some (Iot l1) /\
    l1 < dom h.

Inductive edge_path (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> list Loc -> Prop :=
  | edge_path_nil : forall l,
      edge_path h l l []
  | edge_path_cons : forall l0 l1 l2 nodes,
      heap_edge h l0 l1 ->
      edge_path h l1 l2 nodes ->
      edge_path h l0 l2 (l1 :: nodes).

Fixpoint reachable_in (h : heap) (fuel : nat) (l0 l1 : Loc) : Prop :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => l0 = l1
  | S fuel' =>
      l0 = l1 \/
      exists next, heap_edge h l0 next /\ reachable_in h fuel' next l1
  end.

Inductive reachable_abs (CT : class_table) (h : heap) : Loc -> Loc -> Prop :=

  | reachable_abs_heap : forall l
      (Hdom : l < dom h),
      reachable_abs CT h l l

  | reachable_abs_step : forall l0 l1 any C vals k
      (Hdom        : l1 < dom h)
      (Hobj        : runtime_getObj h l0 = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type any C) vals))
      (Hfield      : nth_error vals k = Some (Iot l1))
      (Hmut_abs    : sf_mutability_rel CT C k RDM_f \/ sf_mutability_rel CT C k Imm_f)
      (Hassign_abs : sf_assignability_rel CT C k RDA \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C k Final),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l1

  | reachable_abs_trans : forall l0 l1 l2
      (Hreach1 : reachable_abs CT h l0 l1)
      (Hreach2 : reachable_abs CT h l1 l2),
      reachable_abs CT h l0 l2.

Definition protected_locset
  (CT : class_table) (h : heap) (l_root : Loc) : Ensembles.Ensemble Loc :=
  fun l_target => reachable_abs CT h l_root l_target.

Lemma initial_frame_inv : forall CT sΓ rΓ h E_mid y zs argtypes Ty ly vals msig_static msig_run,
  wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h ->
  static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty ->
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some argtypes ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly) ->
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals ->
  wf_senv CT (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) ->
  signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig_run ->
  method_signature_refinement CT msig_run msig_static ->
  Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty T)) argtypes (mparams msig_static) ->
  (forall o, runtime_getObj h ly = Some o -> base_subtype CT (rctype (rt_type o)) (sctype (mreceiver msig_run))) ->
  (match E_mid with Some _ =>
     (forall l1, runtime_getVal {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |} 0 = Some (Iot l1) ->
        r_muttype h l1 = Some Mut_r)
   | None => True end) ->
  (forall i T l, nth_error (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) i = Some T ->
     sqtype T = RDM -> runtime_getVal {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |} i = Some (Iot l) ->
     match E_mid with Some _ => safe CT (dom h) h l | None => True end) ->
  Inv CT (dom h) E_mid h (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |}.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ rΓ h E_mid y zs argtypes Ty ly vals msig_static msig_run
         Hcfg Hget_y Hget_zs Hval_y Hargs Hwfs Hno Hsig Harg Hrecv Hthis Hrdm.
  destruct Hcfg as [Hwfct [Hheap [Hrenv [Hwsenv [Hlen0 Hclause]]]]].
  assert (Hlenp : length (mparams msig_run) = length (mparams msig_static))
    by (eapply msr_length; exact Hsig).
  assert (Hlen : length (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) = length (vars {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |})).
  { simpl.
    pose proof (Forall2_length _ _ _ Harg) as H1.
    pose proof (static_getType_list_length _ _ _ Hget_zs) as H2.
    pose proof (runtime_lookup_list_length _ _ _ Hargs) as H3. lia. }
  unfold wf_renv in Hrenv.
  destruct Hrenv as [_ [Hthis0 Hvals_ok]].
  destruct Hthis0 as [iot [Hiot Hiotlt]].
  destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h iot Hiotlt) as [oth Hoth].
  assert (Hctx : r_muttype h iot = Some (rqtype (rt_type oth))).
  { unfold r_muttype. unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite Hoth. reflexivity. }
  (* helper: caller's wf_r_typable for a var index *)
  assert (Hcaller : forall i sqt loc, i < length sΓ -> nth_error sΓ i = Some sqt ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot loc) ->
      exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt)).
  { intros i sqt loc Hi Hn Hv.
    pose proof (Hclause iot (rqtype (rt_type oth)) Hiot Hctx i Hi sqt Hn) as Hcl.
    rewrite Hv in Hcl. unfold wf_r_typable in Hcl.
    destruct (r_type h loc) as [rqt|] eqn:Er; [|contradiction].
    destruct Hcl as [Hbs _]. exists rqt. split; [reflexivity|exact Hbs]. }
  refine {| inv_wfct := Hwfct; inv_len := Hlen; inv_wfsenv := Hwfs; inv_class_dom := _;
            inv_h0 := Nat.le_refl (dom h); inv_this := Hthis;
            inv_agree := _; inv_bot := _; inv_mut_safe := _; inv_rdm_safe := Hrdm;
            inv_wfrt := _; inv_htype := _ |}.
  - (* class_dom *) intros l o Ho.
    assert (Hl : l < dom h) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Ho; exact Ho).
    pose proof (wf_obj_parts CT h l o Hheap Hl Ho) as [Hrt [Hdom _]]. exact Hdom.
  - (* agree *) intros i T l Hn Hval.
    destruct i as [|k].
    + simpl in Hn. inversion Hn; subst T.
      unfold runtime_getVal in Hval. simpl in Hval. inversion Hval; subst l.
      assert (His : List.In (Iot ly) (vars rΓ)) by (eapply List.nth_error_In; exact Hval_y).
      rewrite Forall_forall in Hvals_ok.
      pose proof (Hvals_ok (Iot ly) His) as Hlyok. simpl in Hlyok.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h ly) as [o|] eqn:Eo; [|contradiction].
      exists (rt_type o). split.
      * unfold r_type. rewrite Eo. reflexivity.
      * exact (Hrecv o eq_refl).
    + simpl in Hn. unfold runtime_getVal in Hval. simpl in Hval.
      assert (Hk : k < length (mparams msig_run)) by (eapply nth_error_Some_lt; exact Hn).
      assert (Hk0 : k < length (mparams msig_static)) by (rewrite <- Hlenp; exact Hk).
      destruct (nth_error_exists_lt (mparams msig_static) k Hk0) as [T0 Hn0].
      destruct (Forall2_nth_Some_r _ _ _ _ _ Harg Hn0) as [argT [HnthT Hqsub]].
      destruct (static_getType_list_nth sΓ zs argtypes k argT Hget_zs HnthT) as [z0 [Hzs Hgetz]].
      destruct (runtime_lookup_list_nth rΓ zs vals k (Iot l) Hargs Hval) as [z1 [Hzs1 Hvalz]].
      assert (z0 = z1) by (eapply nth_error_Some_eq; eauto). subst z1.
      assert (Hiz : z0 < length sΓ) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hgetz; exact Hgetz).
      destruct (Hcaller z0 argT l Hiz Hgetz Hvalz) as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|].
      assert (Hbs0 : base_subtype CT (sctype argT) (sctype T0)).
      { exact (qualified_type_subtype_base CT argT (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty T0) Hqsub). }
      assert (Hdom0 : sctype T0 < dom CT) by (eapply base_subtype_dom_r; exact Hbs0).
      assert (Hbs1 : base_subtype CT (sctype T0) (sctype T)).
      { eapply msr_param_base; eauto. }
      eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs|eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs0|exact Hbs1]].
  - (* bot *) intros i T Hn Hq. destruct Hno as [Hnm Hfa].
    destruct i as [|k].
    + simpl in Hn. inversion Hn; subst T. exfalso. exact (nonmut_not_bot _ Hnm Hq).
    + simpl in Hn. exfalso. rewrite Forall_forall in Hfa.
      pose proof (Hfa T (ltac:(eapply List.nth_error_In; exact Hn))) as HnmT.
      exact (nonmut_not_bot _ HnmT Hq).
  - (* mut *) intros i T l Hn Hq Hval. destruct Hno as [Hnm Hfa].
    destruct i as [|k].
    + simpl in Hn. inversion Hn; subst T. exfalso. exact (nonmut_not_mut _ Hnm Hq).
    + simpl in Hn. exfalso. rewrite Forall_forall in Hfa.
      pose proof (Hfa T (ltac:(eapply List.nth_error_In; exact Hn))) as HnmT.
      exact (nonmut_not_mut _ HnmT Hq).
  - (* wfrt *) intros l o Ho.
    assert (Hl : l < dom h) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Ho; exact Ho).
    exact (proj1 (wf_obj_parts CT h l o Hheap Hl Ho)).
  - (* htype *) intros l o Ho fdefs0 HCF0.
    assert (Hl : l < dom h) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Ho; exact Ho).
    destruct (wf_obj_parts CT h l o Hheap Hl Ho) as [_ [_ [fdefs [HCF [Hlenf Hfa]]]]].
    assert (Hfeq : fdefs0 = fdefs) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst fdefs0.
    split; [exact Hlenf|].
    intros g fdef Hnth v Hget.
    destruct v as [|l2]; [exact I|].
    destruct (Forall2_nth_Some _ _ _ _ _ Hfa Hget) as [fdef' [Hnth' HR]].
    assert (fdef' = fdef) by (eapply nth_error_Some_eq; eauto). subst fdef'.
    destruct (runtime_getObj h l2) as [o2|] eqn:Eo2.
    + simpl in HR. destruct HR as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]]. exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|exact Hbs].
    + simpl in HR. contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma wf_senv_append : forall CT sΓ q c,
  wf_senv CT sΓ -> wf_stypeuse CT q c -> wf_senv CT (sΓ ++ [Build_qualified_type q c]).
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ q c [Hdom Hfa] Hwf. split.
  - change (0 < length (sΓ ++ [Build_qualified_type q c])).

Lemma update_field_at : forall h l f v o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l =
  Some (mkObj (rt_type o) (update f v (fields_map o))).
Proof.
  intros h l f v o H. unfold update_field. rewrite H.
  unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_same. apply nth_error_Some_lt in H. lia.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_other : forall h l l' f v, l <> l' ->
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l' = runtime_getObj h l'.
Proof.
  intros h l l' f v Hne. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - unfold set_fields_map. apply update_nth_diff. auto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_length : forall h l f v, length (update_field h l f v) = length h.

  intros h l f v. unfold update_field.
  destruct (runtime_getObj h l) as [o|]; [|reflexivity].
  unfold set_fields_map. apply update_length.
Qed.

Lemma update_field_target_rt : forall h l l' f v o o',
  runtime_getObj (update_field h l f v) l' = Some o' -> runtime_getObj h l' = Some o ->
  rt_type o' = rt_type o.
Proof.
  intros h l l' f v o o' H' H.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec l l') as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l'. rewrite (update_field_at h l f v o H) in H'. inversion H'; auto.

  rewrite (update_field_other h l l' f v Hne) in H'. rewrite H in H'. inversion H'; auto.

  intros h l f v o o' H H'. rewrite (update_field_at h l f v o H) in H'. inversion H'; auto.

(* ===================== readonly-state invariant (qctx-based) ===================== *)

Definition MutHeld (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = Mut /\
              runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition RDMHeld (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = RDM /\
              runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition MutClosed
    (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env)
    (ME : Loc -> Prop) (lc : Loc) : Prop :=
  forall l', mut_reach CT h lc l' ->
    h0 <= l' /\
    (exists o, runtime_getObj h l' = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r) /\
    ~ RDMHeld sΓ rΓ l'.

Definition Qreach
    (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env)
    (ME : Loc -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall lc, ME lc -> MutClosed CT h0 h sΓ rΓ ME lc.

Definition ProtectedField
    (CT : class_table) (C : class_name) (f : var) : Prop :=
  sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA.

Definition PresFrom (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h h' : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l, l < h0 -> forall C anyrq vals vals' f,
    runtime_getObj h l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals) ->
    runtime_getObj h' l = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals') ->
    ProtectedField CT C f ->
    nth_error vals f = nth_error vals' f.

Definition BelowRT (h0 : nat) (h h' : heap) : Prop :=
  forall l, l < h0 -> exists o o',
    runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ runtime_getObj h' l = Some o' /\
    rt_type o' = rt_type o.

Record InvR (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (qctx : q_r) (ME : Loc -> Prop)
            (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) : Prop := {
  invR_wfct : wf_class_table CT;
  invR_len : length sΓ = length rΓ.(vars);
  invR_wfsenv : wf_senv CT sΓ;
  invR_class_dom : forall l o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
      rctype (rt_type o) < dom CT;
  invR_h0 : h0 <= dom h;
  invR_agree : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype T);
  invR_loc : forall i l, runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) -> l < dom h;
  invR_bot : forall i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Bot ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some Null_a;
  invR_this : forall l0, runtime_getVal rΓ 0 = Some (Iot l0) ->
      r_muttype h l0 = Some qctx;
  invR_rcv : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
      exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
        qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype T) qctx;
  invR_hqual : forall l o fdefs g fdef v,
      runtime_getObj h l = Some o ->
      CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->
      nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef ->
      getVal (fields_map o) g = Some v ->
      match v with
      | Null_a => True
      | Iot l' => exists rqt, r_type h l' = Some rqt /\
          qualifier_typable_heap (rqtype rqt)
            (vpa_mutability_rec_fld (rqtype (rt_type o)) (mutability (ftype fdef)))
      end;
  invR_htype : heap_type_ok CT h;
  invR_me : forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Mut ->
      runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) -> ME l;
  invR_qreach : Qreach CT h0 h sΓ rΓ ME;
}.

Lemma invR_mut_facts : forall CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  forall i T l, nth_error sΓ i = Some T -> sqtype T = Mut ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l) ->
  h0 <= l /\ exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI i T l Hn Hq Hv.
  pose proof (invR_me CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI i T l Hn Hq Hv) as Hme.
  pose proof (invR_qreach CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI l Hme l (mut_reach_nil CT h l)) as [Hge [Hobj _]].
  split; [exact Hge|]. destruct Hobj as [o [Ho Hqr]]. exists o. split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma invR_mut_closed_new : forall CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  forall lc, ME lc -> MutClosed CT h0 h sΓ rΓ ME lc.
Proof. intros. exact (invR_qreach CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ H lc H0). Qed.

Lemma invR_rdm_not_closed : forall CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  forall lc, ME lc -> forall l', mut_reach CT h lc l' -> ~ RDMHeld sΓ rΓ l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI lc Hme l' Hr.
  pose proof (invR_qreach CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI lc Hme l' Hr) as [_ [_ Hnr]].
  exact Hnr.
Qed.

Lemma mut_reach_step : forall CT h a b c,

Proof. intros. eapply mut_reach_cons; eauto. Qed.

Lemma inv_update_var : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ x T v,
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  x <> 0 ->
  (forall l, v = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype T)) ->
  (sqtype T = Bot -> v = Null_a) ->
  (sqtype T = Mut -> v = Null_a \/ (exists l, v = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l)) ->
  (sqtype T = RDM -> match E with Some _ => v = Null_a \/ (exists l, v = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l) | None => True end) ->
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ (set_vars rΓ (update x v rΓ.(vars))).
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ x T v HI Hget Hx0 HA HB HM HR.
  case: HI => Hwfct Hlen Hwfs Hcd Hh0 Hthis Hag Hbot Hmut Hrdm Hwfrt Hhtype.
  assert (Hx : x < length sΓ) by (apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hget; exact Hget).
  assert (Hxr : x < length rΓ.(vars)) by lia.
  refine {| inv_wfct := Hwfct; inv_len := _; inv_wfsenv := Hwfs; inv_class_dom := Hcd;
            inv_h0 := Hh0; inv_this := _;
            inv_agree := _; inv_bot := _; inv_mut_safe := _; inv_rdm_safe := _;
            inv_wfrt := Hwfrt; inv_htype := Hhtype |}.
  - (* len *) simpl. rewrite update_length. exact Hlen.
  - (* this *) destruct E as [ee|]; [|exact I]. intros l1 Hv.
    rewrite runtime_set_vars_get in Hv.
    rewrite (update_nth_diff x 0 v (vars rΓ) Hx0) in Hv.
    apply Hthis. exact Hv.
  - (* agree *) intros i T' l Hn Hval. rewrite runtime_set_vars_get in Hval.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + subst i.
      assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) x = Some v) by (apply update_nth_same; exact Hxr).
      rewrite Hup in Hval. inversion Hval; subst v.
      unfold static_getType in Hget. rewrite Hget in Hn. inversion Hn; subst; clear Hn.
      eapply HA; eauto.
    + assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) i = nth_error (vars rΓ) i) by (apply update_nth_diff; auto).
      rewrite Hup in Hval. eapply Hag; eauto.
  - (* bot *) intros i T' Hn Hq. rewrite runtime_set_vars_get.
    destruct (Nat.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].
    + subst i.
      assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) x = Some v) by (apply update_nth_same; exact Hxr).
      rewrite Hup. unfold static_getType in Hget. rewrite Hget in Hn. inversion Hn; subst; clear Hn.
      rewrite (HB Hq). reflexivity.
    + assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) i = nth_error (vars rΓ) i) by (apply update_nth_diff; auto).
      rewrite Hup. eapply Hbot; eauto.

    + subst i.
      assert (Hup : nth_error (update x v (vars rΓ)) x = Some v) by (apply update_nth_same; exact Hxr).
      rewrite Hup in Hval. inversion Hval; subst v.
      unfold static_getType in Hget. rewrite Hget in Hn. inversion Hn; subst; clear Hn.

Proof. intros CT h0 h l Hl C anyrq vals vals' f H1 H2 HP. rewrite H1 in H2. inversion H2. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma BelowRT_refl : forall h0 h, h0 <= dom h -> BelowRT h0 h h.
Proof.
  intros h0 h Hh l Hl. destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h l (lt_of_lt_of_le Hl Hh)) as [o Ho].
  exists o, o. split; [exact Ho|]. split; [exact Ho|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma BelowRT_update_field : forall h0 h lx g vv, h0 <= dom h -> BelowRT h0 h (update_field h lx g vv).
Proof.
  intros h0 h lx g vv Hh l Hl.
  destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h l (lt_of_lt_of_le Hl Hh)) as [o Ho].
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec l lx) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l. exists o, (mkObj (rt_type o) (update g vv (fields_map o))). split; [exact Ho|]. split.
    + apply update_field_at; exact Ho.
    + reflexivity.
  - assert (Hne' : lx <> l) by auto.
    exists o, o. split; [exact Ho|]. split.
    + rewrite (update_field_other h lx l g vv Hne'). exact Ho.
    + reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma BelowRT_append : forall h0 h og, h0 <= dom h -> BelowRT h0 h (h ++ [og]).
Proof.
  intros h0 h og Hh l Hl.
  destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h l (lt_of_lt_of_le Hl Hh)) as [o Ho].
  exists o, o. split; [exact Ho|]. split.
  - unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l (lt_of_lt_of_le Hl Hh)). exact Ho.
  - reflexivity.

Lemma BelowRT_trans : forall h0 h1 h2 h3,
  BelowRT h0 h1 h2 -> BelowRT h0 h2 h3 -> BelowRT h0 h1 h3.
Proof.

  destruct (H12 l Hl) as [o1 [o2 [H1 [H2 Heq12]]]].
  destruct (H23 l Hl) as [o2' [o3 [H2' [H3 Heq23]]]].
  assert (o2' = o2) by congruence. subst o2'.
  exists o1, o3. split; [exact H1|]. split; [exact H3|]. rewrite Heq23. exact Heq12.

Lemma update_field_rtype_same : forall h lx g v l,
  r_type (update_field h lx g v) l = r_type h l.
Proof.
  intros h lx g v l. destruct (Nat.eq_dec l lx) as [Heq|Hne].
  - subst l. unfold r_type.
    destruct (runtime_getObj h lx) as [o|] eqn:Eo.
    + rewrite (update_field_at h lx g v o Eo). simpl. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (update_field_none h lx g v Eo). unfold r_type. rewrite Eo. reflexivity.
  - unfold r_type. rewrite (update_field_other h lx l g v (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))). reflexivity.
Qed.

  mut_edge CT (h ++ [og]) a b -> a < dom h -> mut_edge CT h a b.
Proof.
  intros CT h og a b H Ha. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  unfold runtime_getObj in H0.
  assert (H0' : runtime_getObj h a = Some o) by
    (unfold runtime_getObj; rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og a Ha) in H0; exact H0).
  eapply mut_edge_intro; eauto.

Lemma mut_edge_facts : forall CT h a b, mut_edge CT h a b ->
  exists o fdefs g fdef, runtime_getObj h a = Some o /\
    CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs /\
    nth_error fdefs g = Some fdef /\
    (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f) /\
    getVal (fields_map o) g = Some (Iot b).
Proof. intros CT h a b H. inversion H; subst; clear H.
  eexists; eexists; eexists; eexists. repeat split; eauto. Qed.

Lemma mut_reach_lt : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l',
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> l < dom h -> l' < dom h.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - exact Hl.
  - apply IH.
    destruct (mut_edge_facts CT h l0 l1 Hedge) as [o [fdefs [g [fdef [Hobj [HCF [Hnth [Hmut Hget]]]]]]]].
    pose proof (inv_htype CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI l0 o Hobj fdefs HCF) as Hht.
    destruct Hht as [Hlen Hf].
    pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.
    destruct Hex as [rqt [Hrt _]]. eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mut_reach_lt : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l',
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> l < dom h -> l' < dom h.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - exact Hl.
  - apply IH.
    destruct (mut_edge_facts CT h l0 l1 Hedge) as [o [fdefs [g [fdef [Hobj [HCF [Hnth [Hmut Hget]]]]]]]].
    pose proof (inv_htype CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI l0 o Hobj fdefs HCF) as Hht.
    destruct Hht as [Hlen Hf].
    pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.
    destruct Hex as [rqt [Hrt _]]. eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma mut_reach_append_old : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og l l',
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ -> mut_reach CT (h ++ [og]) l l' ->
  l < dom h -> mut_reach CT h l l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og l l' HI Hr.
  induction Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 Hedge Htail IH]; intros Hl.
  - apply mut_reach_nil.
  - assert (He : mut_edge CT h l0 l1) by (eapply mut_edge_append_old; eauto).
    assert (Hl1 : l1 < dom h).
    { destruct (mut_edge_facts CT h l0 l1 He) as [o [fdefs [g [fdef [Hobj [HCF [Hnth [Hmut Hget]]]]]]]].
      pose proof (inv_htype CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI l0 o Hobj fdefs HCF) as Hht.
      destruct Hht as [Hlen Hf].
      pose proof (Hf g fdef Hnth (Iot l1) Hget) as Hex.
      destruct Hex as [rqt [Hrt _]]. eapply r_type_some_lt; eauto. }
    eapply mut_reach_cons; [exact He | apply IH; exact Hl1].
Qed.

Lemma safe_append : forall CT h0 h og l,
  (forall l', mut_reach CT (h ++ [og]) l l' -> mut_reach CT h l l') ->
  safe CT h0 h l -> safe CT h0 (h ++ [og]) l.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h og l Htrans [Hcore Hcl]. split.
  - destruct Hcore as [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]]. split; [exact Hge|].
    exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
    unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1.
    pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l o Ho1) as Hlt.
    unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l Hlt). exact Ho1.
  - intros l' Hr. pose proof (Hcl l' (Htrans l' Hr)) as [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]].
    split; [exact Hge|]. exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
    unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1. pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l' o Ho1) as Hlt.
    unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l' Hlt). exact Ho1.
Qed.


Lemma mut_reach_from_new : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og a l',
  mut_reach CT (h ++ [og]) a l' ->
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  (forall l1, mut_edge CT (h ++ [og]) a l1 -> l1 < dom h) ->
  l' = a \/
  (exists l1, mut_edge CT (h ++ [og]) a l1 /\ l1 < dom h /\ mut_reach CT h l1 l').
Proof.
  intros CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ og a l' Hr.
  destruct Hr as [l0 | l0 l1 l2 He Ht]; intros HI Hf.
  - left; reflexivity.
  - right. exists l1. split; [exact He |].
    assert (Hl1 : l1 < dom h) by (apply Hf; exact He).
    split; [exact Hl1 |]. eapply mut_reach_append_old; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_core_append_old : forall h0 h og l,
  safe_core h0 h l -> safe_core h0 (h ++ [og]) l.
Proof.
  intros h0 h og l [Hge [o [Ho1 Ho2]]]. split; [exact Hge|].
  exists o. split; [|exact Ho2].
  unfold runtime_getObj in Ho1. pose proof (nth_error_Some_lt h l o Ho1) as Hlt.
  unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h og l Hlt). exact Ho1.
Qed.

Lemma initial_frame_inv : forall CT sΓ rΓ h E_mid y zs argtypes Ty ly vals msig_static msig_run,

  static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty ->
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some argtypes ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly) ->
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals ->
  wf_senv CT (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) ->
  signature_has_no_mutable_roots msig_run ->
  method_signature_refinement CT msig_run msig_static ->
  Forall2 (fun arg T => qualified_type_subtype CT arg (vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state Ty T)) argtypes (mparams msig_static) ->
  (forall o, runtime_getObj h ly = Some o -> base_subtype CT (rctype (rt_type o)) (sctype (mreceiver msig_run))) ->
  (match E_mid with Some _ =>
     (forall l1, runtime_getVal {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |} 0 = Some (Iot l1) ->
        r_muttype h l1 = Some Mut_r)
   | None => True end) ->
  (forall i T l, nth_error (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) i = Some T ->
     sqtype T = RDM -> runtime_getVal {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |} i = Some (Iot l) ->
     match E_mid with Some _ => safe CT (dom h) h l | None => True end) ->
  Inv CT (dom h) E_mid h (mreceiver msig_run :: mparams msig_run) {| vars := Iot ly :: vals |}.

    pose proof (static_getType_list_length _ _ _ Hget_zs) as H2.

      exists rqt, r_type h loc = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype sqt)).

Lemma stmt_preserve_ro_gen : forall CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h',

  forall mt h0 qctx ME sΓ sΓ',
    (mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState) ->
    stmt_typing CT sΓ mt s sΓ' ->
    InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
    res = OK ->
    exists ME', InvR CT h0 qctx ME' h' sΓ' rΓ' /\
      (forall l, ME l -> ME' l) /\
      PresFrom CT h0 h h' /\ BelowRT h0 h h'.
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' He.
  induction He; intros mt h0 qctx ME sΓ sΓ' Hmt Hty HI Hres.
  - (* SBS_Skip *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    exists ME. split; [exact HI|]. split; [auto|]. split.
    + apply PresFrom_refl.
    + apply BelowRT_refl. exact (invR_h0 CT h0 qctx ME h _ _ HI).
  - (* SBS_Local *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    exists ME. split.
    + eapply invR_local_append; eauto.
    + split; [auto|]. split.
      * apply PresFrom_refl.
      * apply BelowRT_refl. exact (invR_h0 CT h0 qctx ME h _ _ HI).
  - (* SBS_Assign *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    set (ME' := fun z => ME z \/ (sqtype Tx = Mut /\ v2 = Iot z)).
    assert (HA : forall l, v2 = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
        base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Tx)).
    { intros l Hl. destruct (expr_agree_R CT sΓ' h0 qctx ME h rΓ e Te mt v2 Htype_e Hmt Heval HI l Hl)
        as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|].
      exact (base_trans CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Te) (sctype Tx) Hbs
               (qualified_type_subtype_base CT Te Tx Hsub)). }
    assert (HRcv : forall l, v2 = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
        qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt) (sqtype Tx) qctx).
    { intros l Hl. destruct (expr_rcv_R CT sΓ' h0 qctx ME h rΓ e Te mt v2 Htype_e Hmt Heval HI l Hl)
        as [rqt [Hrt Hqtc]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|].
      exact (qtc_mono (rqtype rqt) (sqtype Te) (sqtype Tx) qctx Hqtc
               (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub)). }
    assert (HBot : sqtype Tx = Bot -> v2 = Null_a).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      rewrite Hq in Hqsub. apply qsub_bot_cases in Hqsub.
      exact (expr_bot_R CT sΓ' h0 qctx ME h rΓ e Te mt v2 Htype_e Hmt Heval HI Hqsub). }
    assert (HMe' : forall i T' l, nth_error sΓ' i = Some T' -> sqtype T' = Mut ->
        runtime_getVal (set_vars rΓ (update x v2 rΓ.(vars))) i = Some (Iot l) -> ME' l).
    { intros i T' l Hn Hq' Hval'. rewrite runtime_set_vars_get in Hval'.
      destruct (Nat.eq_dec i x) as [Heq|Hne].
      - subst i.
        assert (Hxv : x < length (vars rΓ)).
        { apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hget_x. rewrite <- (invR_len CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ HI). exact Hget_x. }
......
           inversion Hval; subst l. rewrite length_app. simpl. lia.
        -- assert (Hval0 : runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l)).

           pose proof (invR_loc CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ HI i l Hval0). rewrite length_app. simpl. lia.

             - assert (HT : T' = Tx) by (eapply nth_error_Some_eq; eauto). subst T'.
               rewrite Hmutx in Hq'. discriminate Hq'. }
           subst lc.
           exact (snew_mut_closed CT h0 qctx ME ME' h sΓ' rΓ (set_vars rΓ (update x (Iot (dom h)) rΓ.(vars)))
                    c consig field_defs vals ys argtypes q_c (cqualifier consig)
                    (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals)
                    HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc HqcM (eq_refl _) HRDMe HnotRDM l' Hmr).
      * (* rcont *) intros c0 l' Hrdm Hrr.
        destruct (RDMHeld_set_vars_update_elim sΓ' rΓ x (Iot (dom h)) c0 Hrdm) as [Hold | [T' [Hg' [Hq' Hv']]]].

           { destruct Hold as [i [T [Hn [Hq Hv]]]].

           pose proof (rdm_reach_append_old_R CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ
                         (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals) c0 l' HI Hrr Hc0lt)
             as Hrold.

           unfold ME' in Hme'. destruct Hme' as [Hme | [Hmutx Heq]].
           ++ assert (Hlc : lc < dom h) by (eapply invR_me_loc; eauto).
              pose proof (mut_reach_append_old_R CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ
                            (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals) lc l' HI Hmr Hlc)

           ++ subst lc.
              assert (Hlt : l' < dom h) by (eapply rdm_reach_lt_R; eauto).
              assert (Hog' : mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals =

                by reflexivity.

                          (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals) (dom h) l' Hmr HI
                          (fun l1 He => snew_mut_edge_lt CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ ys vals
                                          (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals)
                                          l1 HI Hargs Hog' He))
                as [Heq' | [l1e [Hedge [Hl1e Hhl]]]].
              ** subst l'. lia.

                            l1e HI HCF Hlen2 HF2 Hget_args Hargs Harg_sub Hqc HqcM Hedge). }
                 exact (Hnot (ex_intro _ l1e (conj Hme1 Hhl))).

           eapply new_wfrt_step. exact Hqc.

        assert (Hlt : l < dom h) by (pose proof (invR_h0 CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ HI); lia).
        unfold runtime_getObj in Hh'.
        rewrite (nth_error_app_mid h (mkObj (mkruntime_type (vpa_mutability_object_creation qctx q_c) c) vals) l Hlt) in Hh'.
        unfold runtime_getObj in Hh.
        rewrite Hh' in Hh. inversion Hh. subst. reflexivity.
      * (* BelowRT *) apply BelowRT_append. exact (invR_h0 CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ' rΓ HI).

    edestruct (IHHe1 mt h0 qctx ME sΓ sΓ'0 Hmt Htype1 HI eq_refl)
      as [ME1 [HI1 [Hmono1 [Hpres1 Hbelow1]]]].
    edestruct (IHHe2 mt h0 qctx ME1 sΓ'0 sΓ' Hmt Htype2 HI1 eq_refl)
      as [ME2 [HI2 [Hmono2 [Hpres2 Hbelow2]]]].
    exists ME2. split; [exact HI2|]. split.
    + intros l Hl. apply Hmono2, Hmono1, Hl.
    + split.
      * eapply PresFrom_trans; [exact Hbelow1|exact Hpres1|exact Hpres2].
      * eapply BelowRT_trans; [exact Hbelow1|exact Hbelow2].
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_first *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_NPE_second *) discriminate Hres.
  - (* SBS_Seq_MUTATIONEXP_first *) discriminate Hres.

Lemma stmt_preserve_gen : forall CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h',
  eval_stmt CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' ->
  forall h0 E sΓ sΓ' (Hty : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState s sΓ'),
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  res = OK ->
  Inv CT h0 E h' sΓ' rΓ' /\
  (forall l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe CT h0 h' l) /\
  (forall l, l < h0 -> runtime_getObj h' l = runtime_getObj h l).
Proof.
  intros CT rΓ h s res rΓ' h' He.
  induction He; intros h0 E sΓ sΓ' Hty HI Hres.
  - (* SBS_Skip *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty. split; [exact HI|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Local *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    split; [eapply inv_local_append; eauto|]. split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign *) inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    assert (HA : forall l, v2 = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\
              base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Tx)).
    { intros l Hl. edestruct (expr_agree CT sΓ' h0 E h rΓ e Te TransitiveState v2 Htype_e (or_intror eq_refl) Heval HI l Hl) as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
      exists rqt. split; [exact Hrt|]. eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs | apply qualified_type_subtype_base; exact Hsub]. }
    assert (HB : sqtype Tx = Bot -> v2 = Null_a).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HM : sqtype Tx = Mut -> v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l)).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_mut_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].
      - rewrite Hro in Hq. discriminate.
      - left. eapply expr_bot_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | exact Hbot]. }
    assert (HR : sqtype Tx = RDM ->
              match E with Some _ => v2 = Null_a \/ (exists l, v2 = Iot l /\ safe CT h0 h l) | None => True end).
    { intros Hq. pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT Te Tx Hsub) as Hqsub.
      apply q_subtype_char in Hqsub as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]].
      - eapply expr_rdm_safe; [exact Htype_e | right; reflexivity | exact Heval | exact HI | rewrite Heq; exact Hq].

      - destruct E as [ee|]; [|exact I]. left.

    split.
    + eapply inv_update_var; eauto.
    + split; auto.
  - (* SBS_Assign_NPE *) discriminate Hres.

    assert (HqM : sqtype Tx = Mut).

Definition MutHeld (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = Mut /\
              runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition RDMHeld (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  exists i T, nth_error sΓ i = Some T /\ sqtype T = RDM /\
              runtime_getVal rΓ i = Some (Iot l).

Definition MutClosed
    (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env)
    (ME : Loc -> Prop) (lc : Loc) : Prop :=
  forall l', mut_reach CT h lc l' ->
    h0 <= l' /\
    (exists o, runtime_getObj h l' = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r) /\
    ~ RDMHeld sΓ rΓ l'.

Definition Qreach
    (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (sΓ : s_env) (rΓ : r_env)
    (ME : Loc -> Prop) : Prop :=
  forall lc, ME lc -> MutClosed CT h0 h sΓ rΓ ME lc.

      CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fdefs ->

      mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f ->

Theorem transitive_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ TransitiveState stmt sΓ')
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg)),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
         Hstmt Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj.
  subst stmt.
  inversion Heval; subst; clear Heval.
  assert (Ely0 : ly0 = ly) by congruence. subst ly0.
  assert (Evals0 : vals0 = vals) by congruence. subst vals0.
  match goal with H : eval_stmt CT _ h _ OK _ h' |- _ => rename H into Hebody end.
  rename mdef0 into mdef_run.
  destruct Hfind as [Hfmn_run Hmb]. subst mbody.
  inversion Htyping; subst; clear Htyping.
  - (* ST_Call *) destruct Hscope as [Habs|[Hcs _]]; [discriminate Habs|discriminate Hcs].
  - (* ST_Call_readonly_state *)
    rename mdef0 into mdef_sta.
    rename Hfind_m into Hfmn_static.
    rename Harg_sub into Hargsub.
    rename Hmt_sub into Hmtsub.
    assert (ETy : Ty0 = Ty) by congruence. subst Ty0.
    assert (Hwfct := proj1 Hwf).
    assert (Hheap := proj1 (proj2 Hwf)).
    assert (Hrenv := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))).
    assert (Hwfsenv := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf)))).
    assert (Hlen := proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))))).
    assert (Hclause := proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 Hwf))))).
    unfold wf_renv in Hrenv.
    destruct Hrenv as [_ [Hthis0 _]].
    destruct Hthis0 as [iot [Hiot Hiotlt]].
    destruct (nth_error_exists_lt h iot Hiotlt) as [oth Hoth].
    assert (Hctx : r_muttype h iot = Some (rqtype (rt_type oth))).
    { unfold r_muttype. unfold runtime_getObj. rewrite Hoth. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hys : y < length sΓ') by (eapply nth_error_Some_lt; exact Hstatic_type).
    assert (Hbsy : base_subtype CT cy (sctype Ty)).
    { unfold r_basetype in Hbase.
      destruct (runtime_getObj h ly) as [o|] eqn:Eo; [simpl in Hbase; inversion Hbase; subst cy | discriminate Hbase].
      pose proof (Hclause iot (rqtype (rt_type oth)) Hiot Hctx y Hys Ty Hstatic_type) as Hcl.
      rewrite Hget_y in Hcl. unfold wf_r_typable in Hcl.
      destruct (r_type h ly) as [rqt|] eqn:Er; [|contradiction].
      destruct Hcl as [Hbs _]. unfold r_type in Er. rewrite Eo in Er. simpl in Er. inversion Er; subst rqt.
      exact Hbs. }
    pose proof (mss_trans _ Hmtsub) as Hmsc0.
    pose proof (fmn_scope_along CT Hwfct cy (sctype Ty) mindex mdef_run mdef_sta Hbsy Hfmn_run Hfmn_static) as Hsc.
    rewrite Hmsc0 in Hsc.
    pose proof (fmn_sig_refine CT Hwfct cy (sctype Ty) mindex mdef_run mdef_sta Hbsy Hfmn_run Hfmn_static) as Hsig.
    pose proof (fmn_receiver_le CT Hwfct cy mindex mdef_run Hfmn_run) as Hrecv_le.
    pose proof (find_method_wf CT cy mindex mdef_run Hwfct Hfmn_run) as Hwfm.
    unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
    destruct Hwfm as [Hret_wf [sGr [retTr [Hbody [Hlt_r [Hnth_r [Hret_sub_r [Hover [Hsc_cl Hnor]]]]]]]]].
    rewrite Hsc in Hbody.
    rewrite Hsc in Hnor.

Require Import Syntax.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_abstract_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_abstract_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_abstract_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | _, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM => Lost
    | q1, RDM => q1
    | Mut, Mut => Mut
    | _, Mut => Lost
    | _, q2 => q2
  end.

Definition vpa_mutability_tt_readonly_state (t1: qualified_type)(t2 : qualified_type) : qualified_type :=
  Build_qualified_type
    (vpa_mutability_qq_readonly_state (sqtype t1) (sqtype t2))
    (sctype t2).

Definition vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (q1: q)(q2 : q_f) : q :=
  match q1, q2 with






    | RO, RDM_f => Lost
    | q1, RDM_f => q1
    | _, Imm_f => Imm
    | Mut, Mut_f => Mut
    | _, Mut_f => Lost
    | _, RO_f => RO
    end.

Definition vpa_assignability (q1: q) (a1: a) : a :=
  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | _, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

  match q1, a1 with
    | Mut, RDA => Assignable
    | Mut, Assignable => Assignable
    | _, _ => Final
  end.

  match q1, q2 with
    | RO, RDM_c => Lost
    | q1, RDM_c => q1
    | _, Imm_c => Imm
    | _, Mut_c => Mut
    end.

  match q1, q2 with
    | Imm_c, RDM_f => Imm
    | Mut_c, RDM_f => Mut
    | RDM_c, RDM_f => RDM

  sctype (mret b) < dom CT -> base_subtype CT (sctype (mret a)) (sctype (mret b)).
Proof.
  intros CT a b H.
  induction H as [msig | qc overrider overridden Hbound Hbs Hwfs Hcompat | child middle parent Hcm Hmp].
  - intros Hdom. apply base_refl. exact Hdom.
  - intros Hdom. unfold method_override_compatible in Hcompat.
    destruct Hcompat as [_ [_ [Hretrel _]]].
    exact (qualified_type_subtype_base CT _ _ Hretrel).
  - intros Hdom.
    assert (Hbs2 : base_subtype CT (sctype (mret middle)) (sctype (mret parent)))
      by (eapply IHmethod_signature_refinement1; exact Hdom).
    assert (Hdomm : sctype (mret middle) < dom CT) by (eapply base_subtype_dom_l; exact Hbs2).
    assert (Hbs1 : base_subtype CT (sctype (mret child)) (sctype (mret middle)))
      by (eapply Hmp; exact Hdomm).
    eapply base_trans; [exact Hbs1|exact Hbs2].
Qed.

Lemma fmn_mret_prop : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C, (forall D m dC dD, base_subtype CT C D ->
     FindMethodWithName CT C m dC -> FindMethodWithName CT D m dD ->
     (sqtype (mret (msignature dD)) = Mut \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dD)) = RDM) ->
     (sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Mut \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Imm \/
      sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = RDM \/ sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Bot)
     /\ (sqtype (mret (msignature dC)) = Imm -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c)).
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C. induction C as [C IH] using (well_founded_ind Nat.lt_wf_0).
  intros D m dC dD Hsub HlookC HlookD Hq.
  destruct (Nat.eq_dec C D) as [Heq|Hne].
  - assert (D = C) by congruence. subst D.
    rewrite (fmn_det CT C m dC HlookC dD HlookD).
    destruct Hq as [HqM|HqR].
    + split; [left; exact HqM | intros Himm; rewrite HqM in Himm; discriminate Himm].
    + split; [right; right; left; exact HqR | intros Himm; rewrite HqR in Himm; discriminate Himm].
  - edestruct (base_subtype_parent_step CT C D Hsub Hne) as [p [Hpl Hps]].
    edestruct (parent_lookup_some_inv CT C p Hpl) as [def [Hfind Hsup]].
    assert (HpC : p < C) by (eapply wf_class_parent_lt; eauto).
    edestruct (fmn_exists_along CT Hwf p D m dD Hps HlookD) as [dP HlookP].
    pose proof (IH p HpC D m dP dD Hps HlookP HlookD Hq) as [HsetP HimmP].
    inversion HlookC; subst.
    + (* Here *) assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
      pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
      assert (Hin : List.In dC (methods (body def))) by (eapply gget_method_In; exact Hget_method).
      pose proof (Hwm dC Hin) as Hwfm.
      unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
      destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc0 Hnor]]]]]]]]].
      pose proof (Hover def p dP (class_qualifier (signature def))) as Hover2.
      assert (Hcname : cname (signature def) = C) by (eapply wf_class_table_cname; eauto).
      assert (Hbd : bound CT (cname (signature def)) = Some (class_qualifier (signature def))).
      { unfold bound. rewrite Hcname. rewrite Hfind. auto. }
      assert (Hnm_eq : m = mname (msignature dC)) by (symmetry; eapply gget_method_name; eauto).
      assert (HlookP' : FindMethodWithName CT p (mname (msignature dC)) dP).
      { rewrite <- Hnm_eq. exact HlookP. }
      assert (Hfc : find_class CT (cname (signature def)) = Some def).
      { rewrite Hcname. exact Hfind. }
      pose proof (Hover2 Hfc Hsup Hbd HlookP') as Hcompat.
      unfold method_override_compatible in Hcompat.
      destruct Hcompat as [_ [_ [Hretrel _]]].
      assert (Hbound : bound CT C = Some (class_qualifier (signature def))).
      { rewrite <- Hcname. exact Hbd. }
      pose proof (qualified_type_subtype_q CT _ _ Hretrel) as Hqs.
      unfold vpa_mutability_override in Hqs. simpl in Hqs.
      assert (Hqrne : qc2q (class_qualifier (signature def)) <> RO) by (eapply qc2q_not_ro).
      split.
      * eapply vpa_abs_sub_set; [exact Hqrne | exact HsetP | exact Hqs].
      * intros Himm.
        destruct HsetP as [H2|[H2|[H2|H2]]].
        -- (* previous return Mut *)
           destruct (class_qualifier (signature def)); simpl in Hqs.
           all: pose proof Hqs as Hqs2; rewrite H2 in Hqs2; rewrite Himm in Hqs2; simpl in Hqs2;
                exfalso; exact (q_no_imm_mut Hqs2).
        -- (* previous return Imm *)
           eapply bound_const_imm; [exact Hwf| | exact (HimmP H2)].
           eapply base_extends.
           ++ apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hfind. exact Hfind.
           ++ destruct (fmn_find_some CT p m dP HlookP) as [defp Hfp]. apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hfp. exact Hfp.
           ++ unfold parent_lookup. rewrite Hfind. simpl. rewrite Hsup. reflexivity.
        -- (* previous return RDM *)
           destruct (class_qualifier (signature def)) as [| |]; simpl in Hqs.
           ++ pose proof Hqs as Hqs2; rewrite H2 in Hqs2; rewrite Himm in Hqs2; simpl in Hqs2;
              exfalso; exact (q_no_imm_mut Hqs2).
           ++ exact Hbound.
           ++ pose proof Hqs as Hqs2; rewrite H2 in Hqs2; rewrite Himm in Hqs2; simpl in Hqs2;
              exfalso; apply q_subtype_char in Hqs2 as [[_ Heq]|[Hro|Hbot]];
              try discriminate Heq; try discriminate Hro; discriminate Hbot.
        -- (* previous return Bot *)
           destruct (class_qualifier (signature def)); simpl in Hqs.
           all: pose proof Hqs as Hqs2; rewrite H2 in Hqs2; rewrite Himm in Hqs2; simpl in Hqs2;
                exfalso; exact (q_no_imm_bot Hqs2).
    + (* Super *) assert (def0 = def) by congruence. subst def0.
      assert (parent = p) by congruence. subst parent.
      assert (HdC : dC = dP) by (eapply fmn_det; eauto). subst dC.
      split; [exact HsetP|].
      intros Himm.
      eapply bound_const_imm; [exact Hwf| | exact (HimmP Himm)].
      eapply base_extends.
      * apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hfind. exact Hfind.
      * destruct (fmn_find_some CT p m dP HlookP) as [defp Hfp]. apply nth_error_Some_lt in Hfp. exact Hfp.
      * unfold parent_lookup. rewrite Hfind. simpl. rewrite Hsup. reflexivity.
Qed.

Inductive wf_class : class_table -> class_def -> Prop :=


| WFObjectDef : forall CT cdef class_name
    (Hno_super    : cdef.(signature).(super) = None)
    (Hrdm         : cdef.(signature).(class_qualifier) = RDM_c)
    (Hno_fields   : cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields) = [])
    (Hno_methods  : cdef.(body).(methods) = [])
    (Hcname       : cdef.(signature).(cname) = class_name)
    (Hwf_ctor     : wf_constructor_object CT class_name cdef.(body).(constructor))
    (Hwf_fields   : Forall (wf_field CT) cdef.(body).(Syntax.fields))
    (Hnodup       : NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) cdef.(body).(methods))),
    wf_class CT cdef


| WFOtherDef : forall CT cdef superC thisC
    (Hsuper    : cdef.(signature).(super) = Some superC)
    (Hcname    : cdef.(signature).(cname) = thisC)
    (Hordering : thisC > superC),
    let sig := cdef.(signature) in
    let bod := cdef.(body) in
    let C := cname sig in
    let qC := class_qualifier sig in
    (wf_constructor CT C (csignature (constructor bod)) /\
    Forall (wf_method CT C) (methods bod) /\
    NoDup (map (fun mdef => mname (msignature mdef)) (methods bod)) /\
    match bound CT superC with
    | Some q_super =>
        exists fs, CollectFields CT C fs /\
        (qC = q_super \/ q_super = RDM_c) /\
        Forall (wf_field CT) fs
    | None =>
        CollectFields CT C []
    end) ->
    wf_class CT cdef
.

Definition wf_class_table (CT : class_table) : Prop :=
  let object_class_at_zero :=
    exists obj_def, find_class CT 0 = Some obj_def /\
                    super (signature obj_def) = None in
  let non_object_classes_extend_object :=
    forall i def, i > 0 -> find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  super (signature def) <> None in
  let class_name_matches_index :=
    forall i def, find_class CT i = Some def ->
                  cname (signature def) = i in
  Forall (wf_class CT) CT /\
  object_class_at_zero /\
  non_object_classes_extend_object /\
  class_name_matches_index.

Definition is_mut_or_ro (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = RO.

Definition is_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_concrete_or_rdm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = RDM \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_mut_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Mut \/ qualifier = Bot.

Definition is_imm_or_bot (qualifier : q) : Prop :=
  qualifier = Imm \/ qualifier = Bot.

Lemma field_value_agree_R : forall CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o lv fds,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc) ->
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
  FieldLookup CT (sctype T) f fDef ->
  CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fds -> nth_error fds f = Some fDef ->
  getVal (fields_map o) f = Some (Iot lv) ->
  exists rqt', r_type h lv = Some rqt' /\
    base_subtype CT (rctype rqt') (f_base_type (ftype fDef)).
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o lv fds HI Hget Hval Hobj HFL Hcf Hnth Hfield.
  pose proof (invR_htype CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI loc o Hobj fds Hcf) as Hht.
  destruct Hht as [Hlen Hval2].
  exact (Hval2 f fDef Hnth (Iot lv) Hfield).
Qed.

Lemma field_value_rcv_R : forall CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o lv fds,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc) ->
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
  FieldLookup CT (sctype T) f fDef ->
  CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fds -> nth_error fds f = Some fDef ->
  getVal (fields_map o) f = Some (Iot lv) ->
  exists rqt', r_type h lv = Some rqt' /\
    qualifier_typable_context (rqtype rqt')
      (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype T) (mutability (ftype fDef))) qctx.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o lv fds HI Hget Hval Hobj HFL Hcf Hnth Hfield.
  pose proof (invR_rcv CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI x T loc Hget Hval) as Hrcv.
  destruct Hrcv as [rqt [Hrt Hqtc]].
  assert (Hrteq : rqtype rqt = rqtype (rt_type o)).
  { unfold r_type in Hrt. rewrite Hobj in Hrt. inversion Hrt; auto. }
  pose proof (invR_hqual CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI loc o fds f fDef (Iot lv) Hobj Hcf Hnth Hfield) as Hhq.
  simpl in Hhq.
  destruct Hhq as [rqt2 [Hrt2 Hhq2]].
  exists rqt2. split; [exact Hrt2|].
  rewrite <- Hrteq in Hhq2.
  eapply qtc_read; [exact Hqtc|exact Hhq2].
Qed.

Lemma expr_agree_R : forall CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ e Te mt v,

  forall l, v = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Te).

  - inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty. discriminate.

  expr_has_type CT sΓ mt e Te -> (mt = ReadonlyState \/ mt = TransitiveState) ->
  eval_expr CT rΓ h e v OK rΓ h -> Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  forall l, v = Iot l -> exists rqt, r_type h l = Some rqt /\ base_subtype CT (rctype rqt) (sctype Te).
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ h0 E h rΓ e Te mt v Hty Hmt He HI l Hl.
  inversion He; subst; clear He.
  - inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty. discriminate.
  - inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    eapply (inv_agree CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI x Te l Hget Hval).
  - inversion Hty; subst; clear Hty.
    + exfalso. destruct Hmt as [H1|H1]; destruct Hmt0 as [H2|H2]; subst; discriminate.
    + destruct (field_lookup_runtime CT sΓ h0 E h rΓ x f T fDef v0 o HI Hget_x Hval Hobj Hfld_def) as [fds [Hcf Hnth]].

Definition safe_core (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  h0 <= l /\ exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.

Definition safe (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (h : heap) (l : Loc) : Prop :=
  safe_core h0 h l /\ forall l', mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe_core h0 h l'.

Lemma safe_core_safe : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> safe_core h0 h l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [H _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_ge : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l -> h0 <= l.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [[H _] _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_obj : forall CT h0 h l, safe CT h0 h l ->
  exists o, runtime_getObj h l = Some o /\ rqtype (rt_type o) = Mut_r.
Proof. intros CT h0 h l [[_ H] _]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma safe_reach : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_reach CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof.
  intros CT h0 h l l' [Hc Hcl] Hr. split.
  - apply Hcl; exact Hr.
  - intros l'' Hr''. apply Hcl. eapply mut_reach_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma safe_step : forall CT h0 h l l', safe CT h0 h l -> mut_edge CT h l l' -> safe CT h0 h l'.
Proof. intros. eapply safe_reach; eauto. apply mut_reach_cons with (l1:=l'); auto. apply mut_reach_nil. Qed.

Lemma field_value_safe : forall CT h0 h loc o fds g fdef lv,
  safe CT h0 h loc ->
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o -> CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fds ->
  nth_error fds g = Some fdef ->
  (mutability (ftype fdef) = Mut_f \/ mutability (ftype fdef) = RDM_f) ->
  getVal (fields_map o) g = Some (Iot lv) ->
  safe CT h0 h lv.
Proof.
  intros. eapply safe_step; [exact H |].
  eapply mut_edge_intro; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma field_receiver_bot_false : forall CT sΓ h0 E h rΓ x T loc,
  Inv CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc) ->
  sqtype T = Bot -> False.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ h0 E h rΓ x T loc HI Hget Hval Hq.
  pose proof (inv_bot CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ HI x T Hget Hq) as Hb.

Qed.

Lemma wf_rtypeuse_new : forall CT c consig q_c qthisr,
  bound CT c = Some (cqualifier consig) ->
  vpa_mutability_bound (qc2q q_c) (cqualifier consig) = qc2q q_c ->
  c < dom CT ->
  wf_rtypeuse CT (vpa_mutability_object_creation qthisr q_c) c.
Proof.
  intros CT c consig q_c qthisr Hb Hq Hc. unfold wf_rtypeuse. rewrite Hb. split; [exact Hc|].
  destruct (cqualifier consig), q_c, qthisr; simpl in *; try discriminate; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma bound_parent_imm : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C P, parent_lookup CT C = Some P -> bound CT P = Some Imm_c -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C P Hpl HP.
  unfold parent_lookup in Hpl.
  destruct (find_class CT C) as [def|] eqn:Ef; [|discriminate].
  simpl in Hpl.
  pose proof (find_class_in CT C def Ef) as Hin.
  pose proof (wf_class_table_Forall CT Hwf) as Hall. rewrite Forall_forall in Hall.
  pose proof (Hall def Hin) as Hwc.
  inversion Hwc; subst.
  - rewrite Hno_super in Hpl. discriminate.
  - assert (HS : superC = P) by congruence. subst superC.
    rewrite HP in H. simpl in H.
    destruct H as [_ [_ [_ Hex]]].
    destruct Hex as [fs Hbody].
    destruct Hbody as [_ Hbody].
    destruct Hbody as [Hdisj _].
    unfold bound. rewrite Ef. simpl.
    change (Some qC = Some Imm_c).
    destruct Hdisj as [Hq|Hbad].
    + rewrite Hq. reflexivity.
    + discriminate Hbad.
Qed.

Lemma bound_const_imm : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C A, base_subtype CT C A -> bound CT A = Some Imm_c -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C A H. induction H; intros HA.
  - exact HA.
  - eapply IHbase_subtype1; [exact Hwf | eapply IHbase_subtype2; [exact Hwf | exact HA]].
  - eapply bound_parent_imm; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_rtypeuse_imm_rq : forall CT l q, wf_rtypeuse CT q l -> bound CT l = Some Imm_c -> q = Imm_r.
Proof.
  intros CT l q H Hb. unfold wf_rtypeuse in H. rewrite Hb in H.
  destruct H as [_ Hag]. destruct q; simpl in Hag; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma inv_mut_imm_excl : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ y Ty ly o,
  forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1. induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst; clear H2;
    try reflexivity; try congruence.
  - assert (def = def0) by congruence. subst def0.
    assert (parent = parent0) by congruence. subst parent0.
    rewrite (IHCollectFields parent_fields0 Hparent_cf). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma FieldLookup_det : forall CT C f fd1, FieldLookup CT C f fd1 ->
  forall fd2, FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 H1 fd2 H2.
  inversion H1; inversion H2; subst; clear H1; clear H2.
  assert (fields = fields0) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst.
  rewrite Hget in Hget0. inversion Hget0; auto.
Qed.

Lemma find_class_some_eq : forall CT C d1 d2, find_class CT C = Some d1 -> find_class CT C = Some d2 -> d1 = d2.

Lemma base_subtype_dom_r : forall CT C D, base_subtype CT C D -> D < dom CT.

Lemma find_class_of_lt : forall CT C, C < dom CT -> exists d, find_class CT C = Some d.

Lemma bound_parent_imm : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C P, parent_lookup CT C = Some P -> bound CT P = Some Imm_c -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C P Hpl HP.
  unfold parent_lookup in Hpl.
  destruct (find_class CT C) as [def|] eqn:Ef; [|discriminate].
  simpl in Hpl.
  pose proof (find_class_in CT C def Ef) as Hin.
  pose proof (wf_class_table_Forall CT Hwf) as Hall. rewrite Forall_forall in Hall.
  pose proof (Hall def Hin) as Hwc.
  inversion Hwc; subst.
  - rewrite Hno_super in Hpl. discriminate.
  - assert (HS : superC = P) by congruence. subst superC.
    rewrite HP in H. simpl in H.
    destruct H as [_ [_ [_ Hex]]].
    destruct Hex as [fs Hbody].
    destruct Hbody as [_ Hbody].
    destruct Hbody as [Hdisj _].
    unfold bound. rewrite Ef. simpl.
    change (Some qC = Some Imm_c).
    destruct Hdisj as [Hq|Hbad].
    + rewrite Hq. reflexivity.
    + discriminate Hbad.
Qed.

Lemma bound_const_imm : forall CT, wf_class_table CT ->
  forall C A, base_subtype CT C A -> bound CT A = Some Imm_c -> bound CT C = Some Imm_c.
Proof.
  intros CT Hwf C A H. induction H; intros HA.
  - exact HA.
  - eapply IHbase_subtype1; [exact Hwf | eapply IHbase_subtype2; [exact Hwf | exact HA]].
  - eapply bound_parent_imm; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_rtypeuse_imm_rq : forall CT l q, wf_rtypeuse CT q l -> bound CT l = Some Imm_c -> q = Imm_r.
Proof.
  intros CT l q H Hb. unfold wf_rtypeuse in H. rewrite Hb in H.
  destruct H as [_ Hag]. destruct q; simpl in Hag; try discriminate; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma inv_mut_imm_excl : forall CT h0 E h sΓ rΓ y Ty ly o,
  forall fs2, CollectFields CT C fs2 -> fs1 = fs2.
Proof.
  intros CT C fs1 H1. induction H1; intros fs2 H2; inversion H2; subst; clear H2;
    try reflexivity; try congruence.
  - assert (def = def0) by congruence. subst def0.
    assert (parent = parent0) by congruence. subst parent0.

Lemma FieldLookup_det : forall CT C f fd1, FieldLookup CT C f fd1 ->
  forall fd2, FieldLookup CT C f fd2 -> fd1 = fd2.
Proof.
  intros CT C f fd1 H1 fd2 H2.
  inversion H1; inversion H2; subst; clear H1; clear H2.
  assert (fields = fields0) by (eapply CollectFields_det; eauto). subst.

Qed.

  parent_lookup CT C = super (signature d).
Proof. intros. unfold parent_lookup. rewrite H. auto. Qed.

Lemma base_subtype_dom_l : forall CT C D, base_subtype CT C D -> C < dom CT.
Proof. intros CT C D H. induction H; auto. Qed.

Lemma base_subtype_dom_r : forall CT C D, base_subtype CT C D -> D < dom CT.
Proof. intros CT C D H. induction H; auto. Qed.

Lemma find_class_of_lt : forall CT C, C < dom CT -> exists d, find_class CT C = Some d.
Proof.
  intros CT C H. unfold find_class. destruct (nth_error CT C) as [d|] eqn:E.

Theorem readonly_state_preservation :
  forall CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
    (Hstmt : stmt = (SCall x mindex y zs))
    (Hstatic_type : static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty)
    (Hmethod_lookup : FindMethodWithName CT (sctype Ty) mindex mdef)
    (Hwf : wf_r_config CT sΓ rΓ h)
    (Htyping : stmt_typing CT sΓ mt stmt sΓ')
    (Hreadonly_scope : readonly_state_method_scope mt)
    (Heval : eval_stmt CT rΓ h stmt OK rΓ' h')
    (Hget_y : runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some (Iot ly))
    (Hget_zs : runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals)
    (HinP: Ensembles.In Loc (reachable_locations_from_vals h (Iot ly :: vals)) loc_arg)
    (Harg_obj : runtime_getObj h loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg))
    (Hassign : sf_assignability_rel CT C f Final \/ sf_assignability_rel CT C f RDA),
    exists vals_arg',
      runtime_getObj h' loc_arg = Some (mkObj (mkruntime_type anyrq C) vals_arg') /\
      nth_error vals_arg f = nth_error vals_arg' f.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ mt rΓ h stmt rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly
         loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f
         Hstmt Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Hreadonly_scope Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj Hassign.
  subst stmt.
  destruct Hreadonly_scope as [Hmt|Hmt]; subst mt.
  - (* mt = ReadonlyState *)
    inversion Htyping; subst; clear Htyping.
    + (* ST_Call *) destruct Hscope as [Habs|[Hcs _]]; [discriminate Habs|discriminate Hcs].
    + (* ST_Call_readonly_state *)
      inversion Hmt_sub; subst.
      * (* callee scope ReadonlyState *) admit.
      * (* callee scope TransitiveState *)
        assert (HtypingT : stmt_typing CT sΓ' TransitiveState (SCall x mindex y zs) sΓ').
        { eapply (ST_Call_readonly_state CT sΓ' TransitiveState x mindex y zs argtypes Tthis Tx Ty0 mdef0).
          - exact Hwf0.
          - exact Hget_x.
          - exact Hget_y0.
          - exact Hget_args.
          - exact Hthis.
          - exact Hfind_m.
          - exact Hnot_rcv.
          - exact Hmt_not_abs.
          - exact Hmt_not_cs.
          - exact Hret_sub.
          - exact Hrcv_sub.
          - exact Harg_sub.
          - discriminate.
          - discriminate.
          - rewrite <- H0. apply method_subtyping_refl. }
        exact (transitive_state_preservation CT sΓ' rΓ h (SCall x mindex y zs) rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f eq_refl Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf HtypingT Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj).
  - (* mt = TransitiveState *)
    exact (transitive_state_preservation CT sΓ rΓ h (SCall x mindex y zs) rΓ' h' sΓ' x y mindex Ty mdef zs vals ly loc_arg C anyrq vals_arg f eq_refl Hstatic_type Hmethod_lookup Hwf Htyping Heval Hget_y Hget_zs HinP Harg_obj).

Lemma find_method_wf : forall CT C m mdef, wf_class_table CT ->
  FindMethodWithName CT C m mdef -> wf_method CT (sctype (mreceiver (msignature mdef))) mdef.
Proof.
  intros CT C m mdef Hwf Hfm. induction Hfm.
  - pose proof (wf_class_methods CT C def Hwf Hfind) as [Hwm _].
    pose proof (gget_method_In _ _ _ Hget_method) as Hin.
    rewrite Hown in Hin. pose proof (Hwm mdef Hin) as Hwfm.
    unfold wf_method in Hwfm.
    destruct Hwfm as [Hret [sG' [retT [Hbody [Hlt [Hnth [Hsubst [Hover [Hsc Hnor]]]]]]]]].
    rewrite Hsc. apply (Hwm mdef Hin).
  - apply IHHfm. auto.
Qed.
