---
name: pico-invr-frame-obstruction
description: Why the InvR single-qctx invariant cannot be used for callee frames in the PICO readonly-state proof, and what the alternative must track.
metadata:
  type: project
---

For task card 205 (PICO readonly/transitive state preservation in /workspace/Task.v), the scratch proof at /workspace/.scratch_T.txt has a complete `transitive_state_preservation` and an `InvR`-based readonly body lemma, but the `SBS_Call` case cannot construct an `InvR` frame for the callee body.

Key obstruction: `InvR` requires one `qctx` for the whole environment (`invR_this : r_muttype h 0 = Some qctx`) plus `qualifier_typable_context` (`qtc`) for every entry. A call typed at ReadonlyState can have a static receiver type `Ty = RO` whose runtime object has qtype `Mut_r` (allowed), while the method's run signature has an immutable parameter (no mutable roots is required for Readonly/Transitive bodies). An immutable-static argument whose runtime qtype is `Imm_r` gives `qualifier_typable_context Imm_r Imm Mut_r = False`, so no `qctx` makes the frame invariant true. Choosing caller's qctx instead breaks `SBS_New` (the new object's runtime q is computed from the actual `this` qtype, and e.g. `New x RDM_c` yields `qtc Mut_r RDM Imm_r = False`). Therefore `stmt_preserve_ro_gen` as stated is unprovable for such calls.

The real invariant must be qctx-free/per-entry: e.g. `view_ok qr qs := forall m qv, vpa_ro qs m <> Lost -> qualifier_typable_heap qv (vpa_rec_fld qr m) -> qualifier_typable_heap qv (vpa_ro qs m)`, with `hqual`-style heap invariants and `Bot`/Null, plus the ME closure machinery for RDA writes. For the final readonly theorem, the crucial fact is: an RDA field write has static receiver `Mut` and therefore `safe`/fresh target, while Final fields are never runtime-writable; Assignable-field writes cannot change a protected field index (assignability determinism). See [[pico-scratch-state]].

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_nth : forall rΓ zs vals n v,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> nth_error vals n = Some v ->
  exists x, nth_error zs n = Some x /\ runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some v.
Proof.
  intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H. eapply mapM_nth; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma runtime_lookup_list_length : forall rΓ zs vals,
  runtime_lookup_list rΓ zs = Some vals -> length vals = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold runtime_lookup_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_nth : forall sΓ zs tys n T,
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some tys -> nth_error tys n = Some T ->
  exists x, nth_error zs n = Some x /\ static_getType sΓ x = Some T.
Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. eapply mapM_nth; eauto. Qed.

Lemma static_getType_list_length : forall sΓ zs tys,
  static_getType_list sΓ zs = Some tys -> length tys = length zs.
Proof. intros. unfold static_getType_list in H. apply mapM_length in H. auto. Qed.

(* Forall2 nth *)
Lemma Forall2_nth_Some : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n a0,
  Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l1 n = Some a0 ->
  exists b, nth_error l2 n = Some b /\ R a0 b.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1 l2 n a0. revert l1 l2 a0.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros l1 l2 a HF Hn.
  - destruct l1 as [|x1 xs].
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys]; [simpl in Hn; discriminate|].
      simpl in Hn; discriminate.
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
      * simpl in Hn. rewrite Forall2_cons_iff in HF. destruct HF as [HR _].
        inversion Hn; subst. exists y2; split; auto.
  - destruct l1 as [|x1 xs].
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys]; [simpl in Hn; discriminate|].
      simpl in Hn; discriminate.
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
      * simpl in Hn. rewrite Forall2_cons_iff in HF. destruct HF as [_ HFr].
        edestruct (IH xs ys a HFr) as [b [H1 H2]]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_Some_r : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n b0,
Lemma msr_param_base : forall CT a b, method_signature_refinement CT a b ->
  forall k Ta Tb, nth_error (mparams a) k = Some Ta -> nth_error (mparams b) k = Some Tb ->
  sctype Tb < dom CT -> base_subtype CT (sctype Tb) (sctype Ta).
Proof.
  intros CT a b H.
  induction H as [msig | qc overrider overridden Hbound Hbs Hwfs Hcompat | child middle parent Hcm Hmp].
  - intros k Ta Tb Ha Hb Hdom.
    assert (Ta = Tb) by (eapply nth_error_Some_eq; eauto). subst Ta.
    apply base_refl. exact Hdom.
  - intros k Ta Tb Ha Hb Hdom.
    unfold method_override_compatible in Hcompat.
    destruct Hcompat as [_ [_ [_ [HF2 _]]]].
    destruct (Forall2_nth_Some _ _ _ _ _ HF2 Hb) as [Ta' [Ha' HR]].
    assert (Ta' = Ta) by (eapply nth_error_Some_eq; eauto). subst Ta'.
    exact (qualified_type_subtype_base CT _ _ HR).
  - intros k Ta Tb Ha Hb Hdom.
    assert (Hlen : length (mparams parent) = length (mparams middle)) by (symmetry; eapply msr_length; exact H).
    assert (Hk : k < length (mparams middle)) by (rewrite <- Hlen; eapply nth_error_Some_lt; exact Hb).
    destruct (nth_error_exists_lt (mparams middle) k Hk) as [Tm Hm].
    assert (Hbs1 : base_subtype CT (sctype Tb) (sctype Tm)) by (eapply IHmethod_signature_refinement1; eauto).
    assert (HdomTm : sctype Tm < dom CT) by (eapply base_subtype_dom_r; exact Hbs1).
    assert (Hbs2 : base_subtype CT (sctype Tm) (sctype Ta)) by (eapply Hmp; eauto).
    eapply base_trans with (D := sctype Tm); [exact Hbs1 | exact Hbs2].
Qed.

Record InvR (CT : class_table) (h0 : nat) (qctx : q_r) (ME : Loc -> Prop)

Lemma pres_fldwrite : forall CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ x Tx y Ty loc_x o f val_y fDef a_s a_r,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some Tx ->
  static_getType sΓ y = Some Ty ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc_x) ->
  runtime_getObj h loc_x = Some o ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ y = Some val_y ->
  sf_def_rel CT (sctype Tx) f fDef ->
  sf_assignability_rel CT (sctype Tx) f a_s ->
  sf_assignability_rel CT (rctype (rt_type o)) f a_r ->
  (vpa_assignability (sqtype Tx) a_s = Assignable \/
   vpa_assignability_cs_ts (sqtype Tx) a_s = Assignable) ->
  qualified_type_subtype CT Ty
    (Build_qualified_type
      (vpa_mutability_stype_fld_readonly_state (sqtype Tx) (mutability (ftype fDef)))
      (f_base_type (ftype fDef))) ->
  PresFrom CT h0 h (update_field h loc_x f val_y).
Proof.
  intros CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ x Tx y Ty loc_x o f val_y fDef a_s a_r

Lemma field_lookup_runtime_R : forall CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o,
  InvR CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ ->
  static_getType sΓ x = Some T ->
  runtime_getVal rΓ x = Some (Iot loc) ->
  runtime_getObj h loc = Some o ->
  FieldLookup CT (sctype T) f fDef ->
  exists fds, CollectFields CT (rctype (rt_type o)) fds /\ nth_error fds f = Some fDef.
Proof.
  intros CT sΓ h0 qctx ME h rΓ x f T fDef loc o HI Hget Hval Hobj HFL.
  destruct (invR_agree CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI x T loc Hget Hval) as [rqt [Hrt Hbs]].
  assert (Hrc : rctype (rt_type o) < dom CT) by (eapply (invR_class_dom CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI); eauto).
  destruct (CollectFields_runtime_class CT h loc o (invR_wfct CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI) Hobj Hrc) as [fds Hcf].
  assert (Hrteq : rctype rqt = rctype (rt_type o)).
  { unfold r_type in Hrt. rewrite Hobj in Hrt. inversion Hrt; auto. }
  assert (Hsub : base_subtype CT (rctype (rt_type o)) (sctype T)) by (rewrite <- Hrteq; exact Hbs).
  exists fds. split; [exact Hcf|].
  exact (FieldLookup_index CT (invR_wfct CT h0 qctx ME h sΓ rΓ HI) (rctype (rt_type o)) (sctype T) f fDef Hsub HFL fds Hcf).
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_nth_Some_r : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2 n b0,
  Forall2 R l1 l2 -> nth_error l2 n = Some b0 ->
  exists a, nth_error l1 n = Some a /\ R a b0.
Proof.
  intros A B R l1 l2 n b0. revert l1 l2 b0.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros l1 l2 b HF Hn.
  - destruct l1 as [|x1 xs].
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys]; [simpl in Hn; discriminate|].
      simpl in HF; inversion HF.
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
      * simpl in Hn. rewrite Forall2_cons_iff in HF. destruct HF as [HR _].
        inversion Hn; subst. exists x1; split; auto.
  - destruct l1 as [|x1 xs].
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in Hn; discriminate.
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
    + destruct l2 as [|y2 ys].
      * simpl in HF; inversion HF.
      * simpl in Hn. rewrite Forall2_cons_iff in HF. destruct HF as [_ HFr].
        edestruct (IH xs ys b HFr) as [a [H1 H2]]; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_length : forall {A B} (R:A->B->Prop) l1 l2, Forall2 R l1 l2 -> length l1 = length l2.
Proof. intros A B R l1 l2 H. induction H; simpl; auto. Qed.
